================================================================================
FILE: scripts\autoloads\BaseManager.gd
================================================================================


extends Node

const BASE_REACTOR_POWER: float = 50.0

var active_modules: Array = []
var total_power: float = 0.0
var current_power_draw: float = 0.0
var reactor_energy: float = 100.0
var oxygen_level: float = 100.0
var temp_level: float = 100.0

var health: float = 100.0
var health_drain: float = 4.0
var o2_drain: float = 0.6
var temp_drain: float = 0.5
var reactor_drain_mult: float = 0.4
var hazard_interval: float = 75.0
var day_failed_sent: bool = false
var solar_efficiency: float = 1.0      ## dust storms drop this to 0.5
var failure_roll_interval: float = 24.0
var failure_chance: float = 0.10
var _failure_timer: float = 0.0

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if get_node_or_null("/root/GameManager") != null:
		if GameManager.current_phase != GameManager.Phase.SURVIVE:
			return

	_tick_power_and_systems(delta)
	_tick_random_failures(delta)

func calculate_power() -> void:
	for i in range(active_modules.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		if not is_instance_valid(active_modules[i]):
			active_modules.remove_at(i)

	current_power_draw = 0.0
	total_power = 0.0

	for mod in active_modules:
		if mod.module_name == "Solar Panel":
			mod.is_powered = not mod.is_broken and not mod.is_constructing

	for mod in active_modules:
		if mod.module_name == "Reactor":
			var solar_count: int = mod.get_connected_solar_count()
			if not mod.is_broken and not mod.is_constructing and solar_count > 0 and reactor_energy > 0.0:
				mod.is_powered = true
				total_power += BASE_REACTOR_POWER * pow(2.0, float(solar_count - 1)) * solar_efficiency
			else:
				mod.is_powered = false

	for mod in active_modules:
		if mod.module_name == "Solar Panel" or mod.module_name == "Reactor":
			continue

		if mod.is_broken or mod.is_constructing:
			mod.is_powered = false
			continue

		if mod.is_fed_by_solar():
			mod.is_powered = true
		elif mod.is_fed_by_reactor() and (current_power_draw + mod.power_draw <= total_power):
			mod.is_powered = true
			current_power_draw += mod.power_draw
		else:
			mod.is_powered = false

	if get_node_or_null("/root/EventBus") != null:
		EventBus.power_changed.emit(current_power_draw, total_power)

func _tick_power_and_systems(delta: float) -> void:
	if current_power_draw > 0.0 and total_power > 0.0 and reactor_energy > 0.0:
		var drain_rate: float = (current_power_draw / 100.0) * reactor_drain_mult
		reactor_energy = maxf(0.0, reactor_energy - drain_rate * delta)
		if reactor_energy <= 0.0:
			calculate_power()

	var life_support_active: bool = false
	var thermal_active: bool = false

	for mod in active_modules:
		if not is_instance_valid(mod) or mod.is_broken or mod.is_constructing or not mod.is_powered:
			continue
		if mod.module_name == "Life Support":
			life_support_active = true
		elif mod.module_name == "Thermal Control":
			thermal_active = true

	if life_support_active:
		oxygen_level = minf(100.0, oxygen_level + 2.5 * delta)
	else:
		oxygen_level = maxf(0.0, oxygen_level - o2_drain * delta)

	if thermal_active:
		temp_level = minf(100.0, temp_level + 2.0 * delta)
	else:
		temp_level = maxf(0.0, temp_level - temp_drain * delta)

	var reason := ""
	if oxygen_level <= 0.0:
		reason = "OUT OF AIR!"
	elif temp_level <= 0.0:
		reason = "TOO COLD!"
	if reason != "":
		health = maxf(0.0, health - health_drain * delta)
		if get_node_or_null("/root/EventBus") != null:
			EventBus.game_over.emit(reason)
		if health <= 0.0 and not day_failed_sent:
			day_failed_sent = true
			GameManager.day_failed.emit(reason)
	elif health < 100.0 and oxygen_level > 30.0 and temp_level > 30.0:
		health = minf(100.0, health + 1.5 * delta)

func _tick_random_failures(delta: float) -> void:
	_failure_timer += delta
	if _failure_timer < failure_roll_interval:
		return
	_failure_timer = 0.0

	var candidates: Array[BaseModule] = []
	for mod in active_modules:
		if not is_instance_valid(mod):
			continue
		if mod.is_broken or mod.is_constructing or not mod.is_powered:
			continue
		if mod.has_failure_immunity():
			continue
		candidates.append(mod)

	if candidates.is_empty():
		return

	for mod in candidates:
		if randf() < failure_chance:
			mod.break_module()
			break

func apply_day(day: int) -> void:
	var k := float(clampi(day, 1, 5) - 1)
	failure_roll_interval = maxf(6.0, 24.0 - 4.5 * k)
	failure_chance = 0.10 + 0.05 * k
	hazard_interval = maxf(25.0, 75.0 - 12.0 * k)
	o2_drain = 0.6 + 0.15 * k
	temp_drain = 0.5 + 0.12 * k
	reactor_drain_mult = 0.4 + 0.1 * k
	health_drain = 4.0 + 1.0 * k

func reset_for_day(day: int) -> void:
	active_modules.clear()
	total_power = 0.0
	current_power_draw = 0.0
	reactor_energy = 100.0
	oxygen_level = 100.0
	temp_level = 100.0
	health = 100.0
	_failure_timer = 0.0
	day_failed_sent = false
	solar_efficiency = 1.0
	apply_day(day)

================================================================================
FILE: scripts\autoloads\EventBus.gd
================================================================================

extends Node

@warning_ignore("unused_signal")
signal show_dialogue(portrait: Texture2D, text: String, position: String)

FILE: scripts\autoloads\GameFont.gd

extends Node
const FONT_PATH := "res://resources/fonts/Silkscreen-Regular.ttf"
const FONT_FOLDER := "res://resources/fonts"
const PIXEL_FONT := true

var _font: Font

func get_font() -> Font:
	if _font != null:
		return _font
	var path := FONT_PATH if FONT_PATH != "" else _first_font_in_folder()
	if path != "" and ResourceLoader.exists(path):
		var loaded := load(path) as Font
		if loaded != null:
			if loaded is FontFile and PIXEL_FONT:
				var ff := loaded as FontFile
				ff.antialiasing = TextServer.FONT_ANTIALIASING_NONE
				ff.subpixel_positioning = TextServer.SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_DISABLED
				ff.hinting = TextServer.HINTING_NONE
				ff.generate_mipmaps = false
			_font = loaded
			return _font
	var fallback := SystemFont.new()
	fallback.font_names = PackedStringArray(["Consolas", "DejaVu Sans Mono", "monospace"])
	_font = fallback
	return _font

func _first_font_in_folder() -> String:
	var dir := DirAccess.open(FONT_FOLDER)
	if dir == null:
		return ""
	for f in dir.get_files():
		var name := f.trim_suffix(".import")
		var ext := name.get_extension().to_lower()
		if ext == "ttf" or ext == "otf" or ext == "woff2" or ext == "woff":
			return FONT_FOLDER + "/" + name
	return ""

func _ready() -> void:
	get_font()

func add_to_inventory(item_id: String) -> void:
	inventory[item_id] = inventory.get(item_id, 0) + 1

func remove_from_inventory(item_id: String) -> bool:
	if inventory.get(item_id, 0) > 0:
		inventory[item_id] -= 1
		return true
	return false

func get_item_count(item_id: String) -> int:
	return inventory.get(item_id, 0)

func stage_for_rover_drop() -> bool:
	var has_any := false
	for k in inventory.keys():
		var count: int = inventory[k]
		pending_delivery[k] = count
		if count > 0:
			has_any = true
		inventory[k] = 0
	return has_any

func deliver_pending_supplies() -> void:
	for k in pending_delivery.keys():
		inventory[k] = inventory.get(k, 0) + pending_delivery[k]
		pending_delivery[k] = 0

func budget_for_day(day: int) -> float:
	return 2400.0 + 600.0 * float(day - 1)

func begin_day() -> void:
	for k in inventory.keys():
		inventory[k] = 0
	for k in pending_delivery.keys():
		pending_delivery[k] = 0
	mass_budget = budget_for_day(current_sol)
	current_phase = Phase.BUILD
	BaseManager.reset_for_day(current_sol)

func advance_day() -> void:
	current_sol += 1
	begin_day()

func restart_day() -> void:
	begin_day()

func restart_all() -> void:
	current_sol = 1
	begin_day()

FILE: scripts\autoloads\GameSettings.gd

extends Node

const SAVE_PATH := "user://settings.cfg"

var dirty: bool = false

var default_settings: Dictionary = {
	"particles": true,
	"glow": true,
	"screen_shake": true,
	"low_detail": false,
	"master_volume": 100,
	"sfx_volume": 100,
	"music_volume": 100,
	"resolution": "1920x1080",
	"vsync": true,
	"max_fps": 0,
	"msaa": "Off",
	"window_mode": "Windowed",
	"brightness": 100
}

var settings: Dictionary = {}
var _default_input_map: Dictionary = {}

var _brightness_layer: CanvasLayer
var _brightness_rect: ColorRect
var _brightness_mat: ShaderMaterial

const BRIGHTNESS_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform sampler2D screen_tex : hint_screen_texture, filter_linear_mipmap;
uniform float brightness = 1.0;

void fragment() {
	vec4 col = texture(screen_tex, SCREEN_UV);
	vec3 adj = col.rgb * brightness;
	if (brightness > 1.0) {
		adj += vec3((brightness - 1.0) * 0.12);
	}
	COLOR = vec4(clamp(adj, 0.0, 1.0), col.a);
}
"""

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	_ensure_audio_buses()
	_cache_default_inputs()
	_setup_brightness_overlay()
	settings = default_settings.duplicate(true)
	load_settings()
	load_player_input_map()
	apply_settings()
	get_tree().node_added.connect(_on_node_added)

func _ensure_audio_buses() -> void:
	if AudioServer.get_bus_index("SFX") == -1:
		var idx := AudioServer.bus_count
		AudioServer.add_bus(idx)
		AudioServer.set_bus_name(idx, "SFX")
		AudioServer.set_bus_send(idx, "Master")
	if AudioServer.get_bus_index("Music") == -1:
		var idx := AudioServer.bus_count
		AudioServer.add_bus(idx)
		AudioServer.set_bus_name(idx, "Music")
		AudioServer.set_bus_send(idx, "Master")

func _setup_brightness_overlay() -> void:
	_brightness_layer = CanvasLayer.new()
	_brightness_layer.layer = 120
	add_child(_brightness_layer)

	_brightness_rect = ColorRect.new()
	_brightness_rect.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_brightness_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var sh := Shader.new()
	sh.code = BRIGHTNESS_SHADER
	_brightness_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
	_brightness_mat.shader = sh
	_brightness_rect.material = _brightness_mat
	_brightness_layer.add_child(_brightness_rect)

func _cache_default_inputs() -> void:
	for action in InputMap.get_actions():
		var act_str := str(action)
		if act_str.begins_with("ui_"):
			continue
		_default_input_map[act_str] = InputMap.action_get_events(action).duplicate()

func _on_node_added(node: Node) -> void:
	if node is AudioStreamPlayer:
		var p := node as AudioStreamPlayer
		if p.bus == &"Master":
			var nm := p.name.to_lower()
			if nm.contains("music") or nm.contains("ambient") or nm.contains("audio_player"):
				p.bus = &"Music"
			else:
				p.bus = &"SFX"
	elif node is CPUParticles2D:
		(node as CPUParticles2D).visible = bool(settings.get("particles", true))
	elif node is WorldEnvironment:
		var we := node as WorldEnvironment
		if we.environment != null:
			we.environment.glow_enabled = bool(settings.get("glow", true))

func apply_settings() -> void:
	_apply_audio()
	_apply_display()
	_apply_graphics_and_gameplay()

func _apply_audio() -> void:
	_set_bus_percent("Master", float(settings.get("master_volume", 100)))
	_set_bus_percent("SFX", float(settings.get("sfx_volume", 100)))
	_set_bus_percent("Music", float(settings.get("music_volume", 100)))

func _set_bus_percent(bus_name: String, pct: float) -> void:
	var idx := AudioServer.get_bus_index(bus_name)
	if idx == -1:
		return
	var clamped := clampf(pct, 0.0, 100.0)
	AudioServer.set_bus_mute(idx, clamped <= 0.5)
	if clamped > 0.5:
		AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(idx, linear_to_db(clamped / 100.0))

func _apply_display() -> void:
	var b_val: float = clampf(float(settings.get("brightness", 100)) / 100.0, 0.15, 2.0)
	if _brightness_mat != null:
		_brightness_mat.set_shader_parameter("brightness", b_val)
		_brightness_rect.visible = not is_equal_approx(b_val, 1.0)

	var vsync_on: bool = bool(settings.get("vsync", true))
	DisplayServer.window_set_vsync_mode(DisplayServer.VSYNC_ENABLED if vsync_on else DisplayServer.VSYNC_DISABLED)

	var fps: int = int(settings.get("max_fps", 0))
	Engine.max_fps = fps

	var w_mode: String = str(settings.get("window_mode", "Windowed"))
	match w_mode:
		"Fullscreen":
			DisplayServer.window_set_flag(DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_BORDERLESS, false)
			DisplayServer.window_set_mode(DisplayServer.WINDOW_MODE_FULLSCREEN)
		"Borderless":
			DisplayServer.window_set_mode(DisplayServer.WINDOW_MODE_FULLSCREEN)
			DisplayServer.window_set_flag(DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_BORDERLESS, true)
		_:
			DisplayServer.window_set_flag(DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_BORDERLESS, false)
			DisplayServer.window_set_mode(DisplayServer.WINDOW_MODE_WINDOWED)
			var res_str: String = str(settings.get("resolution", "1920x1080"))
			var parts := res_str.split("x")
			if parts.size() == 2:
				var target_size := Vector2i(int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]))
				if target_size.x > 0 and target_size.y > 0:
					DisplayServer.window_set_size(target_size)

	var msaa_str: String = str(settings.get("msaa", "Off"))
	var vp := get_viewport()
	if vp != null:
		match msaa_str:
			"2x": vp.msaa_2d = Viewport.MSAA_2X
			"4x": vp.msaa_2d = Viewport.MSAA_4X
			"8x": vp.msaa_2d = Viewport.MSAA_8X
			_: vp.msaa_2d = Viewport.MSAA_DISABLED

func _apply_graphics_and_gameplay() -> void:
	var particles_on: bool = bool(settings.get("particles", true))
	var glow_on: bool = bool(settings.get("glow", true))
	var root := get_tree().root
	if root != null:
		_apply_recursive(root, particles_on, glow_on)

func _apply_recursive(n: Node, particles_on: bool, glow_on: bool) -> void:
	if n is CPUParticles2D:
		(n as CPUParticles2D).visible = particles_on
	elif n is WorldEnvironment:
		var we := n as WorldEnvironment
		if we.environment != null:
			we.environment.glow_enabled = glow_on
	elif n is AudioStreamPlayer:
		var p := n as AudioStreamPlayer
		if p.bus == &"Master":
			var nm := p.name.to_lower()
			if nm.contains("music") or nm.contains("ambient") or nm.contains("audio_player"):
				p.bus = &"Music"
			else:
				p.bus = &"SFX"
	for c in n.get_children():
		_apply_recursive(c, particles_on, glow_on)

func reset_settings_to_default() -> void:
	settings = default_settings.duplicate(true)
	apply_settings()
	dirty = false

func reset_inputs_to_default() -> void:
	for act_str in _default_input_map.keys():
		if InputMap.has_action(act_str):
			InputMap.action_erase_events(act_str)
			for ev in _default_input_map[act_str]:
				InputMap.action_add_event(act_str, ev)
	dirty = false

func save_settings() -> void:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	cfg.load(SAVE_PATH)
	for k in settings.keys():
		cfg.set_value("settings", k, settings[k])
	cfg.save(SAVE_PATH)
	dirty = false

func load_settings() -> void:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	if cfg.load(SAVE_PATH) != OK:
		return
	if cfg.has_section("settings"):
		for k in default_settings.keys():
			if cfg.has_section_key("settings", k):
				settings[k] = cfg.get_value("settings", k, default_settings[k])
	dirty = false

func save_player_input_map() -> void:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	cfg.load(SAVE_PATH)
	if cfg.has_section("inputs"):
		cfg.erase_section("inputs")
	for action in InputMap.get_actions():
		var act_str := str(action)
		if act_str.begins_with("ui_"):
			continue
		var serialized: Array = []
		for ev in InputMap.action_get_events(action):
			serialized.append(var_to_str(ev))
		cfg.set_value("inputs", act_str, serialized)
	cfg.save(SAVE_PATH)

func load_player_input_map() -> void:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	if cfg.load(SAVE_PATH) != OK or not cfg.has_section("inputs"):
		return
	for act_str in cfg.get_section_keys("inputs"):
		if not InputMap.has_action(act_str):
			InputMap.add_action(act_str)
		InputMap.action_erase_events(act_str)
		var arr: Array = cfg.get_value("inputs", act_str, [])
		for s in arr:
			var ev = str_to_var(str(s))
			if ev is InputEvent:
				InputMap.action_add_event(act_str, ev)

================================================================================
FILE: scripts\autoloads\Hazards.gd
================================================================================


extends Node
## AUTOLOAD (name it Hazards, put it LAST in the autoload list).
## Runs the two Mars hazards during the SURVIVE phase and reads BaseManager for shield / comms / power.
##
## SOLAR FLARE : Comms (powered) warns 15 s ahead. On impact: a powered Storm Shield blocks everything.
##               Without it: 15 damage, and every RUNNING module fails. Unplugged modules are safe.
## DUST STORM  : cannot be avoided. Every module fails, solar output x0.5 for the storm, 25 damage.
## Modules wired DIRECTLY to a solar panel are immune to both (BaseModule.has_failure_immunity()).
signal demo_finished

const FLARE_WARNING_SECONDS := 15.0
const FLARE_DAMAGE := 15.0
const STORM_DAMAGE := 25.0
const STORM_SOLAR_FACTOR := 0.5
const STORM_SECONDS := 30.0
const FLARE_FX_SECONDS := 3.0
const STORM_FROM_DAY := 2            # day 1 only has flares so new players can learn
const STORM_CHANCE := 0.45
const SHIELD := "Shield"
const COMMS := "Comms"

const AMBER := Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.35)
const ORANGE := Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.25)
const CYAN := Color(0.45, 0.9, 1.0)
const RED := Color(1.0, 0.4, 0.35)

enum S { IDLE, WARNING, STORM, BUSY }
var _state: S = S.IDLE
var _timer := 0.0
var _next_at := -1.0
var _warn_left := 0.0
var _storm_left := 0.0
var _gen := 0
var _fx: HazardFX

func _ready() -> void:
	_fx = HazardFX.new()
	add_child(_fx)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var surviving: bool = GameManager.current_phase == GameManager.Phase.SURVIVE
	if not surviving:
		if _state != S.IDLE or _next_at >= 0.0:
			clear()
		return
	if _next_at < 0.0:
		_next_at = BaseManager.hazard_interval * randf_range(0.6, 1.0)
		_timer = 0.0
	match _state:
		S.IDLE:
			_timer += delta
			if _timer >= _next_at:
				_launch()
		S.WARNING:
			_warn_left -= delta
			_fx.set_warning(_warn_left)
			if _warn_left <= 0.0:
				_flare_hit()
		S.STORM:
			_storm_left -= delta
			if _storm_left <= 0.0:
				_end_storm()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- public
func clear() -> void:
	_gen += 1
	_state = S.IDLE
	_next_at = -1.0
	_timer = 0.0
	BaseManager.solar_efficiency = 1.0
	BaseManager.calculate_power()
	if _fx != null:
		_fx.stop_all()

## Effects only, nothing breaks and nobody gets hurt. Used by the tutorial.
func demo(kind: String) -> void:
	if kind == "storm":
		_fx.start_storm()
		await get_tree().create_timer(7.0).timeout
		_fx.stop_storm()
		await get_tree().create_timer(2.5).timeout
	else:
		_fx.play_flare(false)
		await get_tree().create_timer(FLARE_FX_SECONDS + 0.4).timeout
	demo_finished.emit()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scheduling
func _launch() -> void:
	var storm: bool = GameManager.current_sol >= STORM_FROM_DAY and randf() < STORM_CHANCE
	if storm:
		_start_storm()
	else:
		_start_flare()

func _finish(hazard_name: String) -> void:
	_state = S.IDLE
	_timer = 0.0
	_next_at = maxf(20.0, BaseManager.hazard_interval * randf_range(0.8, 1.2))
	EventBus.hazard_ended.emit(hazard_name)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- solar flare
func _start_flare() -> void:
	EventBus.hazard_started.emit("Solar Flare")
	if _module_running(COMMS):
		_state = S.WARNING
		_warn_left = FLARE_WARNING_SECONDS
		_fx.show_warning(true)
		_fx.toast("Comms picked up a solar flare. Impact in 15 seconds. Unplug your equipment.", AMBER)
	else:
		_flare_hit()

func _flare_hit() -> void:
	var gen := _gen
	_state = S.BUSY
	_fx.show_warning(false)
	var shielded := _module_running(SHIELD)
	_fx.play_flare(shielded)
	if shielded:
		_fx.toast("The storm shield held. The flare did no damage.", CYAN)
	else:
		var broke := _break_modules(true)
		_damage(FLARE_DAMAGE, "SOLAR FLARE RADIATION")
		if broke > 0:
			_fx.toast("Solar flare! -%d health and %d system(s) failed." % [int(FLARE_DAMAGE), broke], RED)
		else:
			_fx.toast("Solar flare! -%d health. Nothing was plugged in, so no equipment failed." % int(FLARE_DAMAGE), RED)
	await get_tree().create_timer(FLARE_FX_SECONDS).timeout
	if gen != _gen:
		return
	_finish("Solar Flare")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- dust storm
func _start_storm() -> void:
	EventBus.hazard_started.emit("Dust Storm")
	_state = S.STORM
	_storm_left = STORM_SECONDS
	BaseManager.solar_efficiency = STORM_SOLAR_FACTOR
	_break_modules(false)
	BaseManager.calculate_power()
	_damage(STORM_DAMAGE, "CAUGHT IN THE DUST STORM")
	_fx.start_storm()
	_fx.toast("Dust storm! Dust got into everything. Equipment failed and solar power is cut in half.", ORANGE)

func _end_storm() -> void:
	BaseManager.solar_efficiency = 1.0
	BaseManager.calculate_power()
	_fx.stop_storm()
	_fx.toast("The dust storm has passed. Solar power is back to normal.", CYAN)
	_finish("Dust Storm")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
func _module_running(module_name: String) -> bool:
	for m in BaseManager.active_modules:
		if is_instance_valid(m) and m.module_name == module_name and m.is_powered and not m.is_broken and not m.is_constructing:
			return true
	return false

## only_running = true: modules that are unplugged / off are left alone (flare).
func _break_modules(only_running: bool) -> int:
	var count := 0
	for m in BaseManager.active_modules.duplicate():
		if not is_instance_valid(m) or m.is_broken or m.is_constructing:
			continue
		if m.module_name == "Solar Panel":
			continue
		if only_running and not m.is_powered:
			continue
		if m.has_failure_immunity():
			continue
		m.break_module()
		count += 1
	return count

func _damage(amount: float, reason: String) -> void:
	BaseManager.health = maxf(0.0, BaseManager.health - amount)
	_fx.hurt_flash()
	if BaseManager.health <= 0.0 and not BaseManager.day_failed_sent:
		BaseManager.day_failed_sent = true
		GameManager.day_failed.emit(reason)

# =====================================================================
class HazardFX extends CanvasLayer:
	const STORM_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform float intensity = 0.0;
uniform float gust = 0.0;
float h21(vec2 p){ p = fract(p * vec2(123.34, 456.21)); p += dot(p, p + 45.32); return fract(p.x * p.y); }
float vn(vec2 p){ vec2 i = floor(p); vec2 f = fract(p); vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
	return mix(mix(h21(i), h21(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), u.x), mix(h21(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), h21(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), u.x), u.y); }
float fbm(vec2 p){ float v = 0.0; float a = 0.5; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++){ v += a * vn(p); p = p * 2.02 + vec2(5.1, 2.7); a *= 0.5; } return v; }
void fragment(){
	vec2 res = 1.0 / SCREEN_PIXEL_SIZE;
	float asp = res.x / res.y;
	vec2 uv = UV;
	vec2 p = vec2(uv.x * asp, uv.y);
	float t = TIME;
	float g = 0.75 + 0.25 * sin(t * 0.6) + gust * 0.5;
	float haze = fbm(vec2(p.x * 0.9 - t * 0.9 * g, p.y * 1.6 + t * 0.05));
	float st = 0.0;
	for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++){
		float fi = float(i);
		float sp = 2.2 + fi * 1.6;
		vec2 q = vec2(p.x * (0.25 + fi * 0.08) - t * sp * g, p.y * (7.0 + fi * 9.0) + fi * 13.0);
		st += smoothstep(0.52, 0.85, fbm(q)) * (0.55 - fi * 0.12);
	}
	vec2 gq = floor(vec2(p.x * 60.0 - t * 220.0 * g, p.y * 140.0));
	float grit = step(0.992, h21(gq)) * (0.6 + 0.4 * h21(gq + 3.0));
	float e = smoothstep(0.25, 1.0, length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(1.0, 1.15)));
	float a = intensity * (0.26 + 0.34 * haze + 0.36 * e);
	a += intensity * st * 0.30 + intensity * grit * 0.5;
	vec3 dust = mix(vec3(0.42, 0.17, 0.06), vec3(0.95, 0.52, 0.20), haze);
	dust = mix(dust, vec3(1.0, 0.72, 0.38), clamp(st * 0.6 + grit, 0.0, 1.0));
	dust *= mix(1.0, 0.55, e);
	COLOR = vec4(dust, clamp(a, 0.0, 0.88));
}
"""
	# Flare look adapted from the opening cutscene's sun shader (same fbm, flare_burst blob + ring, same colour ramp).
	const FLARE_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
render_mode blend_add;
uniform float age = -1.0;
uniform float strength = 1.0;
uniform vec4 core_col : source_color = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 0.98, 1.0);
uniform vec4 mid_col : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.85, 0.40, 1.0);
uniform vec4 edge_col : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.58, 0.15, 1.0);
float hash21(vec2 p){ vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031); p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33); return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z); }
float noise(vec2 p){ vec2 i = floor(p); vec2 f = fract(p); vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
	return mix(mix(hash21(i), hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), u.x), mix(hash21(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), u.x), u.y); }
float fbm(vec2 p){ float v = 0.0; float a = 0.5; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++){ v += a * noise(p); p = p * 2.03 + vec2(3.1, 7.3); a *= 0.5; } return v; }
float flare_burst(vec2 p, vec2 c, float a, float w){
	if (a < 0.0) { return 0.0; }
	float d = length(p - c);
	float env = smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, a) * exp(-a * 0.55);
	float rad = 0.16 + a * 0.22;
	float blob = exp(-(d * d) / (rad * rad));
	float ring = exp(-pow((d - a * 0.75) / 0.05, 2.0));
	return (blob * 1.9 + ring * 0.5) * env * w;
}
void fragment(){
	vec2 res = 1.0 / SCREEN_PIXEL_SIZE;
	float asp = res.x / res.y;
	vec2 p = (UV - 0.5) * 2.0;
	p.x *= asp;
	vec2 sun = vec2(asp * 0.72, -0.72);
	float flash = smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, age) * exp(-age * 1.5);
	float d = length(p - sun);
	float ang = atan(p.y - sun.y, p.x - sun.x);
	float x = exp(-d * 0.85) * flash * 1.7;
	x += pow(abs(sin(ang * 9.0 + fbm(vec2(ang * 3.0, age * 0.6)) * 4.0)), 6.0) * exp(-d * 1.05) * flash * 0.9;
	x += flare_burst(p, sun, age, 1.0);
	x += flare_burst(p, sun + vec2(-0.5, 0.35), age - 0.18, 0.8);
	x += flare_burst(p, sun + vec2(-1.1, 0.75), age - 0.34, 0.6);
	x += flash * 0.50 * (0.7 + 0.5 * fbm(p * 2.0 + age));
	x *= strength;
	vec3 c1 = mix(edge_col.rgb * vec3(0.55, 0.12, 0.05), edge_col.rgb, smoothstep(0.0, 0.55, x));
	c1 = mix(c1, mid_col.rgb, smoothstep(0.50, 1.15, x));
	c1 = mix(c1, core_col.rgb, smoothstep(1.05, 1.90, x));
	COLOR = (age < 0.0) ? vec4(0.0) : vec4(c1 * clamp(x, 0.0, 1.4), 1.0);
}
"""
	const EDGE_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform float pulse = 0.0;
uniform vec4 col : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.7, 0.2, 1.0);
void fragment(){
	float e = smoothstep(0.35, 1.0, length((UV - 0.5) * 1.35));
	COLOR = vec4(col.rgb, e * pulse * 0.7);
}
"""
	var storm: ColorRect
	var flare: ColorRect
	var edge: ColorRect
	var hurt: ColorRect
	var warn_label: Label
	var toasts: VBoxContainer
	var wind: AudioStreamPlayer
	var sfx: AudioStreamPlayer
	var beep: AudioStreamPlayer
	var _storm_level := 0.0
	var _shake := 0.0
	var _warn_on := false
	var _warn_left := 0.0
	var _last_beep := -1
	var _t := 0.0
	var _storm_tween: Tween

	func _make_rect(code: String) -> ColorRect:
		var r := ColorRect.new()
		r.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		r.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		r.color = Color.WHITE
		if code != "":
			var sh := Shader.new()
			sh.code = code
			var mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
			mat.shader = sh
			r.material = mat
		add_child(r)
		return r

	func _ready() -> void:
		layer = 60
		storm = _make_rect(STORM_SHADER)
		(storm.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("intensity", 0.0)
		storm.visible = false
		flare = _make_rect(FLARE_SHADER)
		flare.visible = false
		edge = _make_rect(EDGE_SHADER)
		edge.visible = false
		hurt = _make_rect("")
		hurt.color = Color(1.0, 0.15, 0.05, 0.0)

		warn_label = Label.new()
		warn_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		warn_label.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_TOP)
		warn_label.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
		warn_label.position.y = 90
		warn_label.add_theme_font_override("font", GameFont.get_font())
		warn_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
		warn_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.3))
		warn_label.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.9))
		warn_label.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 6)
		warn_label.visible = false
		add_child(warn_label)

		toasts = VBoxContainer.new()
		toasts.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		toasts.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM)
		toasts.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
		toasts.grow_vertical = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN
		toasts.offset_bottom = -70
		toasts.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_END
		add_child(toasts)

		wind = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
		wind.stream = SynthSfx.wind_wav()
		wind.volume_db = -60.0
		add_child(wind)
		sfx = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
		sfx.stream = SynthSfx.flare_wav()
		sfx.volume_db = -3.0
		add_child(sfx)
		beep = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
		beep.stream = SynthSfx.beep_wav()
		beep.volume_db = -8.0
		add_child(beep)
		if AudioServer.get_bus_index("SFX") != -1:
			sfx.bus = &"SFX"
			beep.bus = &"SFX"

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		_t += delta
		var amount := _storm_level * 2.2 + _shake
		_shake = maxf(0.0, _shake - delta * 22.0)
		var cam := get_viewport().get_camera_2d()
		if cam != null:
			cam.offset = Vector2(randf_range(-1.0, 1.0), randf_range(-1.0, 1.0)) * amount if amount > 0.05 else Vector2.ZERO
		if storm.visible:
			(storm.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("gust", maxf(0.0, sin(_t * 0.8) * sin(_t * 0.37 + 1.0)))
		if _warn_on:
			var p := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 7.0)
			warn_label.modulate.a = 0.55 + 0.45 * p
			(edge.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("pulse", 0.35 + 0.65 * p)
		if hurt.color.a > 0.0:
			hurt.color.a = maxf(0.0, hurt.color.a - delta * 1.6)

	# ---------------- storm
	func start_storm() -> void:
		storm.visible = true
		if _storm_tween != null:
			_storm_tween.kill()
		_storm_tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
		_storm_tween.tween_method(func(v: float) -> void:
			_storm_level = v
			(storm.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("intensity", v), _storm_level, 1.0, 2.5)
		wind.play()
		_storm_tween.tween_property(wind, "volume_db", -4.0, 2.5)

	func stop_storm() -> void:
		if _storm_tween != null:
			_storm_tween.kill()
		_storm_tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
		_storm_tween.tween_method(func(v: float) -> void:
			_storm_level = v
			(storm.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("intensity", v), _storm_level, 0.0, 3.0)
		_storm_tween.tween_property(wind, "volume_db", -60.0, 3.0)
		_storm_tween.chain().tween_callback(func() -> void:
			storm.visible = false
			wind.stop())

	# ---------------- flare
	func play_flare(shielded: bool) -> void:
		var mat := flare.material as ShaderMaterial
		if shielded:
			mat.set_shader_parameter("strength", 0.35)
			mat.set_shader_parameter("core_col", Color(0.9, 0.95, 1.0))
			mat.set_shader_parameter("mid_col", Color(0.5, 0.65, 1.0))
			mat.set_shader_parameter("edge_col", Color(0.4, 0.3, 0.9))
		else:
			mat.set_shader_parameter("strength", 1.0)
			mat.set_shader_parameter("core_col", Color(1.0, 1.0, 0.98))
			mat.set_shader_parameter("mid_col", Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.40))
			mat.set_shader_parameter("edge_col", Color(1.0, 0.58, 0.15))
		flare.visible = true
		sfx.play()
		_shake = 5.0 if shielded else 16.0
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_method(func(v: float) -> void: mat.set_shader_parameter("age", v), 0.0, 3.0, 3.0)
		tw.tween_callback(func() -> void:
			mat.set_shader_parameter("age", -1.0)
			flare.visible = false)

	func show_warning(on: bool) -> void:
		_warn_on = on
		warn_label.visible = on
		edge.visible = on
		_last_beep = -1

	func set_warning(left: float) -> void:
		var s := maxi(0, int(ceil(left)))
		warn_label.text = "SOLAR FLARE IN %d" % s
		if s != _last_beep:
			_last_beep = s
			beep.pitch_scale = 1.0 + (15 - s) * 0.03
			beep.play()

	func hurt_flash() -> void:
		hurt.color.a = 0.45

	func stop_all() -> void:
		show_warning(false)
		if _storm_tween != null:
			_storm_tween.kill()
		_storm_level = 0.0
		_shake = 0.0
		storm.visible = false
		(storm.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("intensity", 0.0)
		flare.visible = false
		(flare.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("age", -1.0)
		wind.stop()
		var cam := get_viewport().get_camera_2d()
		if cam != null:
			cam.offset = Vector2.ZERO

	func toast(msg: String, col: Color) -> void:
		var p := PanelContainer.new()
		p.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		sb.bg_color = Color(0.04, 0.05, 0.08, 0.92)
		sb.border_color = col
		sb.set_border_width_all(2)
		sb.content_margin_left = 18
		sb.content_margin_right = 18
		sb.content_margin_top = 8
		sb.content_margin_bottom = 8
		p.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
		var l := Label.new()
		l.text = msg
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", GameFont.get_font())
		l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
		l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
		l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		p.add_child(l)
		toasts.add_child(p)
		p.modulate.a = 0.0
		var tw := p.create_tween()
		tw.tween_property(p, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.18)
		tw.tween_interval(4.5)
		tw.tween_property(p, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.5)
		tw.tween_callback(p.queue_free)

extends CanvasLayer
## Plain fade (used by the cutscene - unchanged) + a new SHUTTER wipe used by day/shop/survival.

var overlay: ColorRect
var transitioning: bool = false

var shutter: ColorRect
var shutter_progress: float = 0.0
var _shutter_mat: ShaderMaterial
var _shutter_tween: Tween

## set by game.gd from its "Transition SFX" exports
var sfx_close: AudioStream
var sfx_open: AudioStream
var sfx_volume_db: float = -4.0

const SHUTTER_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform float progress : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.0;
uniform vec4 edge_color : source_color = vec4(0.4, 0.9, 1.0, 1.0);
uniform float strips = 12.0;
float hash(float n) { return fract(sin(n * 91.345) * 43758.5453); }
void fragment() {
	vec2 uv = UV;
	float row = floor(uv.y * strips);
	float stagger = hash(row) * 0.4;
	float p = clamp((progress * 1.4 - stagger), 0.0, 1.0);
	p = p * p * (3.0 - 2.0 * p);
	// alternate rows sweep in from opposite sides so they meet in the middle
	float x = (mod(row, 2.0) < 1.0) ? uv.x : 1.0 - uv.x;
	float covered = step(x, p);
	float d = x - p;
	float moving = step(0.001, p) * step(p, 0.995);
	float glow = exp(-abs(d) * 55.0) * moving;
	float core = exp(-abs(d) * 260.0) * moving;
	// faint seams between strips that vanish as the screen closes
	float seam = smoothstep(0.0, 0.06, fract(uv.y * strips));
	seam *= smoothstep(1.0, 0.0, fract(uv.y * strips) * 14.0 - 12.0);
	float seam_amt = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.85, 1.0, progress)) * covered;
	vec3 base = vec3(0.012, 0.016, 0.026);
	base += edge_color.rgb * 0.05 * (1.0 - seam) * seam_amt * 6.0;
	base *= 0.94 + 0.06 * sin(uv.y * 900.0);
	vec3 col = base + edge_color.rgb * glow * 0.9 + vec3(1.0) * core * 1.6;
	float a = max(covered, clamp(glow * 0.9 + core, 0.0, 1.0));
	COLOR = vec4(col, a);
}
"""

func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 100
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	overlay = ColorRect.new()
	overlay.color = Color.BLACK
	overlay.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	overlay.modulate.a = 0.0
	add_child(overlay)

	shutter = ColorRect.new()
	shutter.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	shutter.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	shutter.visible = false
	var sh := Shader.new()
	sh.code = SHUTTER_SHADER
	_shutter_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
	_shutter_mat.shader = sh
	shutter.material = _shutter_mat
	add_child(shutter)

func fade_to_black(duration: float = 0.8) -> void:
	overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(overlay, "modulate:a", 1.0, duration)
	await tw.finished

func fade_from_black(duration: float = 0.8) -> void:
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(overlay, "modulate:a", 0.0, duration)
	await tw.finished
	overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

func change_scene(path: String, duration: float = 0.8) -> void:
	if transitioning:
		return
	transitioning = true
	await fade_to_black(duration)
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file(path)
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await fade_from_black(duration)
	transitioning = false

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ shutter wipe â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
func _set_shutter(v: float) -> void:
	shutter_progress = v
	shutter.visible = v > 0.0
	_shutter_mat.set_shader_parameter("progress", v)

func _run_shutter(to: float, duration: float, color: Color) -> void:
	_shutter_mat.set_shader_parameter("edge_color", color)
	if _shutter_tween != null and _shutter_tween.is_valid():
		_shutter_tween.kill()
	shutter.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_play(sfx_close if to >= 1.0 else sfx_open)
	_shutter_tween = create_tween()
	_shutter_tween.tween_method(_set_shutter, shutter_progress, to, duration).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	await _shutter_tween.finished
	if to <= 0.0:
		shutter.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

## Blinds slam shut with a glowing edge.
func shutter_close(duration: float = 0.6, color: Color = Color(0.4, 0.9, 1.0)) -> void:
	await _run_shutter(1.0, duration, color)

## Blinds sweep open.
func shutter_open(duration: float = 0.7, color: Color = Color(0.4, 0.9, 1.0)) -> void:
	await _run_shutter(0.0, duration, color)

func _play(stream: AudioStream) -> void:
	if stream == null:
		return
	var pl := AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	pl.stream = stream
	pl.volume_db = sfx_volume_db
	if AudioServer.get_bus_index("SFX") != -1:
		pl.bus = &"SFX"
	add_child(pl)
	pl.finished.connect(pl.queue_free)
	pl.play()

@onready var anim_player: AnimationPlayer = get_node_or_null("AnimationPlayer")

# state (names kept so other scripts keep working)
