@tool
extends StaticBody2D
class_name WirePort

signal rotated(new_side: int)

@export var rotatable: bool = true
@export var click_radius: float = 14.0
@export var reach: float = 300.0
@export var edge_margin: float = 0.0

const DIRS := [Vector2.RIGHT, Vector2.DOWN, Vector2.LEFT, Vector2.UP]
const SLOT_SPACING := 56.0
const RING_R := 42.0
const TAG_TEXT := "Click to rotate"

static var hover_count: int = 0

var side: int = 0
var hovered: bool = false
var flash: float = 0.0
var pulse_time: float = 0.0

var _center := Vector2.ZERO
var _half := Vector2(64, 64)
var _rot_target: float = 0.0
var _tween: Tween
var _tag_style: StyleBoxFlat

func _ready() -> void:
	if not Engine.is_editor_hint() and scale.x < 0.0 and scale.y < 0.0:
		rotation += PI
		scale = Vector2(absf(scale.x), absf(scale.y))
	_rot_target = rotation
	side = posmod(roundi(rotation / (PI * 0.5)), 4)
	_measure()
	if Engine.is_editor_hint():
		return
	var p := get_parent()
	if p != null and p.has_meta("is_ghost"):
		material = ModuleArt.make_ghost_material()
		rotatable = false
		visible = false      # no plugs on the blueprint preview; they show while it is being built
	_snap_to_edge.call_deferred()

func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if hovered:
		hovered = false
		hover_count = maxi(0, hover_count - 1)
		if hover_count == 0:
			Input.set_default_cursor_shape(Input.CURSOR_ARROW)

func _measure() -> void:
	var p := get_parent()
	if p == null:
		return
	for n in p.get_children():
		if n is CollisionShape2D and (n as CollisionShape2D).shape is RectangleShape2D:
			var cs := n as CollisionShape2D
			_half = (cs.shape as RectangleShape2D).size * 0.5
			_center = cs.position
			return

func _edge_position(s: int, slot: float) -> Vector2:
	var d: Vector2 = DIRS[s]
	var edge := _half.x if d.x != 0.0 else _half.y
	var tangent := Vector2(-d.y, d.x)
	return _center + d * (edge + edge_margin) + tangent * slot * SLOT_SPACING

func _snap_to_edge() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var mates := _ports_on_side(side)
	var slot := float(mates.find(self)) - float(mates.size() - 1) * 0.5
	position = _edge_position(side, slot)

func _ports_on_side(s: int) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	var p := get_parent()
	if p == null:
		return out
	for c in p.get_children():
		if c is WirePort and (c as WirePort).side == s:
			out.append(c)
	return out

func _port_on_side(s: int) -> WirePort:
	var p := get_parent()
	if p == null:
		return null
	for c in p.get_children():
		if c != self and c is WirePort and (c as WirePort).side == s:
			return c as WirePort
	return null

func _build_mode_on() -> bool:
	var pl := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player") as Node2D
	if pl == null or not pl.visible:
		return false
	return pl.get("is_build_mode") == true

func _interactive() -> bool:
	if not rotatable:
		return false
	var p := get_parent()
	if p == null:
		return false
	if p is BaseModule and (p as BaseModule).is_constructing:
		return false
	return _build_mode_on()

func _mouse_hit() -> bool:
	return get_global_mouse_position().distance_to(global_position) <= RING_R

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	pulse_time += delta
	flash = maxf(0.0, flash - delta * 2.2)
	if not Engine.is_editor_hint():
		var h := _interactive() and _mouse_hit()
		if h != hovered:
			hovered = h
			if hovered:
				hover_count += 1
			else:
				hover_count = maxi(0, hover_count - 1)
			Input.set_default_cursor_shape(Input.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND if hover_count > 0 else Input.CURSOR_ARROW)
	queue_redraw()

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if Engine.is_editor_hint() or not hovered:
		return
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
			rotate_side(1)
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
			rotate_side(-1)
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func rotate_side(step: int) -> void:
	var old_side := side
	var new_side := posmod(side + step, 4)
	var other := _port_on_side(new_side)
	_apply_side(new_side, step)
	if other != null:
		other._apply_side(old_side, -step)

func _apply_side(new_side: int, step: int) -> void:
	side = new_side
	var target := _edge_position(side, 0.0)
	_rot_target += float(step) * PI * 0.5
	if _tween != null and _tween.is_valid():
		_tween.kill()
	_tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	_tween.tween_property(self, "position", target, 0.3).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	_tween.tween_property(self, "rotation", _rot_target, 0.3).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	flash = 1.0
	rotated.emit(side)

func _draw_port_fx(_rad: float) -> void:
	if Engine.is_editor_hint():
		return
	var build := _interactive()
	if not build and flash <= 0.01:
		return
	var sc := maxf(absf(global_scale.x), 0.01)
	var r := RING_R / sc
	var w := 2.5 / sc
	var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(pulse_time * 6.0)
	var a := 0.0
	if hovered:
		a = 0.6 + 0.3 * pulse
	elif build:
		a = 0.18 + 0.08 * pulse
	if a > 0.0:
		draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, r, 0.0, TAU, 40, Color(0.55, 1.0, 1.0, a), w, true)
	if flash > 0.01:
		draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, r * (1.0 + (1.0 - flash) * 0.8), 0.0, TAU, 40, Color(1, 1, 1, flash * 0.8), w * 1.5, true)
	if hovered:
		_draw_tag()

func _draw_tag() -> void:
	if _tag_style == null:
		_tag_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
		_tag_style.bg_color = Color(0.07, 0.09, 0.17, 0.92)
		_tag_style.border_color = Color(0.55, 1.0, 1.0, 0.85)
		_tag_style.set_border_width_all(1)
		_tag_style.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	var f := ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var fs := 16
	var tw := f.get_string_size(TAG_TEXT, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs).x
	var cam := get_viewport().get_camera_2d()
	var z := maxf(cam.zoom.x, 0.1) if cam != null else 1.0
	var anchor := global_position + Vector2(0.0, -(RING_R + 26.0) / z)
	draw_set_transform_matrix(get_global_transform().affine_inverse() * Transform2D(0.0, Vector2.ONE / z, 0.0, anchor))
	draw_style_box(_tag_style, Rect2(-tw * 0.5 - 10.0, -fs - 4.0, tw + 20.0, fs + 14.0))
	draw_string(f, Vector2(-tw * 0.5, 0.0), TAG_TEXT, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
	draw_set_transform_matrix(Transform2D.IDENTITY)

static func is_player_in_build_mode(tree: SceneTree) -> bool:
	if tree == null:
		return false
	var p := tree.get_first_node_in_group("player")
	if p != null and "is_build_mode" in p:
		return bool(p.is_build_mode)
	return false

static func can_rotate_port(port: Node2D) -> bool:
	if port == null or not port.is_inside_tree():
		return false
	if not is_player_in_build_mode(port.get_tree()):
		return false
	var parent_mod := port.get_parent()
	if parent_mod != null:
		if parent_mod.has_meta("is_ghost") and bool(parent_mod.get_meta("is_ghost")):
			return true
		if "is_constructing" in parent_mod and bool(parent_mod.is_constructing):
			return false
	return false

static func rotate_port_around_module(port: Node2D) -> void:
	var parent_mod := port.get_parent() as Node2D
	if parent_mod == null:
		port.rotation += PI * 0.5
		return

	var center := Vector2.ZERO
	var col := parent_mod.get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	if col != null:
		center = col.position

	var rel := port.position - center
	port.position = center + Vector2(-rel.y, rel.x)
	port.rotation = fposmod(port.rotation + PI * 0.5, TAU)

FILE: scripts\game systems\wire_reciever.gd

@tool
extends StaticBody2D
class_name WireReceiver

@export var standby_color: Color = Color(0.25, 0.75, 1.0):
	set(value):
		standby_color = value
		queue_redraw()
@export var accepted_sources: PackedStringArray = PackedStringArray()
@export var capacity: int = 1
@export var target_module: BaseModule

var receiver_point: Marker2D = null
var connected_wire: Node2D = null
var connected_wires: Array[Node2D] = []
var pulse_time: float = 0.0
var _is_hovered: bool = false

var housing_style: StyleBoxFlat
var well_style: StyleBoxFlat
var flange_style: StyleBoxFlat

func _ready() -> void:
	var old_sprite: Sprite2D = get_node_or_null("Sprite2D") as Sprite2D
	if old_sprite != null:
		old_sprite.visible = false

	receiver_point = get_node_or_null("ReceiverPoint") as Marker2D
	if receiver_point == null:
		receiver_point = get_node_or_null("RecieverPoint") as Marker2D

	_init_styles()
	queue_redraw()

	if not Engine.is_editor_hint():
		add_to_group("wire_receivers")
		if target_module == null and get_parent() is BaseModule:
			target_module = get_parent() as BaseModule

func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if _is_hovered:
		_is_hovered = false
		WirePort.hover_count = maxi(0, WirePort.hover_count - 1)

func _init_styles() -> void:
	housing_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	housing_style.bg_color = Color(0.17, 0.19, 0.23)
	housing_style.border_color = Color(0.07, 0.08, 0.10)
	housing_style.set_border_width_all(2)
	housing_style.set_corner_radius_all(5)

	well_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	well_style.bg_color = Color(0.08, 0.09, 0.12)
	well_style.border_color = Color(0.25, 0.28, 0.33)
	well_style.set_border_width_all(1)
	well_style.set_corner_radius_all(3)

	flange_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	flange_style.bg_color = Color(0.24, 0.27, 0.32)
	flange_style.border_color = Color(0.09, 0.10, 0.12)
	flange_style.set_border_width_all(1)
	flange_style.set_corner_radius_all(2)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	pulse_time += delta
	if not Engine.is_editor_hint():
		_update_hover_state()
	queue_redraw()

func _update_hover_state() -> void:
	var can_rot := WirePort.can_rotate_port(self)
	var mouse_close := false
	if can_rot:
		var local_m := to_local(get_global_mouse_position())
		mouse_close = Rect2(-22, -36, 44, 72).has_point(local_m)

	if mouse_close and not _is_hovered:
		_is_hovered = true
		WirePort.hover_count += 1
	elif not mouse_close and _is_hovered:
		_is_hovered = false
		WirePort.hover_count = maxi(0, WirePort.hover_count - 1)

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if Engine.is_editor_hint() or not _is_hovered:
		return
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		if WirePort.can_rotate_port(self):
			WirePort.rotate_port_around_module(self)
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
			queue_redraw()

func _clean_wires() -> void:
	for i in range(connected_wires.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		if not is_instance_valid(connected_wires[i]):
			connected_wires.remove_at(i)
	connected_wire = connected_wires.back() if not connected_wires.is_empty() else null

func get_receiver_position() -> Vector2:
	if receiver_point != null:
		return receiver_point.global_position
	return global_position

func accepts_wire(wire_node: Node2D = null) -> bool:
	if target_module == null and get_parent() is BaseModule:
		target_module = get_parent() as BaseModule
	if wire_node == null:
		return true
	if "source_module" in wire_node and is_instance_valid(wire_node.source_module):
		var src_mod: BaseModule = wire_node.source_module
		if src_mod == target_module:
			return false
		if target_module != null and target_module.module_name == "Reactor":
			return src_mod.module_name == "Solar Panel"
		if not accepted_sources.is_empty() and not accepted_sources.has(src_mod.module_name):
			return false
	return true

func can_accept_wire(wire_node: Node2D = null) -> bool:
	_clean_wires()
	if target_module == null and get_parent() is BaseModule:
		target_module = get_parent() as BaseModule
	if target_module == null:
		return false
	if target_module.is_constructing or target_module.is_broken or not target_module.can_accept_wires:
		return false

	# Reactor has infinite capacity for Solar Panel wires; other modules obey capacity
	var is_reactor: bool = (target_module.module_name == "Reactor")
	if not is_reactor and connected_wires.size() >= maxi(1, capacity):
		return false

	return accepts_wire(wire_node)

func accept_wire(wire_node: Node2D) -> void:
	_clean_wires()
	if target_module == null and get_parent() is BaseModule:
		target_module = get_parent() as BaseModule
	if not connected_wires.has(wire_node):
		connected_wires.append(wire_node)
	connected_wire = wire_node
	if target_module != null:
		target_module.accept_wire(wire_node)
	queue_redraw()

func remove_wire(wire_node: Node2D) -> void:
	connected_wires.erase(wire_node)
	_clean_wires()
	if target_module != null:
		target_module.remove_wire(wire_node)
	queue_redraw()

func _get_active_color() -> Color:
	_clean_wires()
	if connected_wire != null and is_instance_valid(connected_wire) and "wire_color" in connected_wire:
		return connected_wire.wire_color
	if target_module != null and target_module.is_broken:
		return Color(1.0, 0.15, 0.15)
	return standby_color

func _draw() -> void:
	if housing_style == null:
		_init_styles()

	_clean_wires()
	var is_plugged_in: bool = not connected_wires.is_empty()
	var active_col: Color = _get_active_color()
	var pulse: float = 0.7 + 0.3 * sin(pulse_time * (6.0 if is_plugged_in else 3.0))

	if _is_hovered:
		draw_rect(Rect2(-20, -35, 40, 70), Color(0.42, 1.0, 0.55, 0.4), false, 2.0)

	draw_rect(Rect2(-14, -30, 32, 64), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.42))
	draw_style_box(flange_style, Rect2(-18, -26, 8, 52))
	draw_style_box(housing_style, Rect2(-14, -32, 30, 64))
	draw_style_box(well_style, Rect2(-8, -22, 20, 44))

	var bolt_col: Color = Color(0.40, 0.44, 0.50)
	draw_circle(Vector2(-10, -27), 1.8, bolt_col)
	draw_circle(Vector2(11, -27), 1.8, bolt_col)
	draw_circle(Vector2(-10, 27), 1.8, bolt_col)
	draw_circle(Vector2(11, 27), 1.8, bolt_col)

	var rail_col: Color = active_col if is_plugged_in else active_col.darkened(0.45)
	rail_col.a = 0.95 if is_plugged_in else 0.55 * pulse
	draw_line(Vector2(-4, -25), Vector2(10, -25), rail_col, 2.5)
	draw_line(Vector2(-4, 25), Vector2(10, 25), rail_col, 2.5)
	draw_line(Vector2(-11, -16), Vector2(-11, 16), rail_col, 2.0)

	var sock_pos: Vector2 = Vector2(6, 0)
	if receiver_point != null:
		sock_pos = receiver_point.position - Vector2(6, 0)

	if is_plugged_in:
		var glow: Color = active_col.lightened(0.25)
		glow.a = 0.35 * pulse
		draw_circle(sock_pos, 12.0, glow)

	draw_circle(sock_pos, 9.0, Color(0.14, 0.16, 0.20))
	draw_arc(sock_pos, 9.0, 0.0, TAU, 24, rail_col, 2.0, true)

	var slot_col: Color = active_col.lightened(0.2) if is_plugged_in else Color(0.03, 0.04, 0.05)
	draw_rect(Rect2(sock_pos + Vector2(-3, -6), Vector2(6, 3.5)), slot_col)
	draw_rect(Rect2(sock_pos + Vector2(-3, 2.5), Vector2(6, 3.5)), slot_col)

	var led_top_col: Color = active_col.lightened(0.25) if is_plugged_in else Color(0.18, 0.20, 0.24)
	draw_circle(Vector2(0, -15), 2.2, led_top_col)
	draw_circle(Vector2(0, 15), 2.2, led_top_col)

================================================================================
FILE: scripts\inheritance\BaseModule.gd

extends StaticBody2D
class_name BaseModule

const ZONE_PAD: float = 110.0

@export var module_name: String = "Module"
@export var mass_cost: float = 1000.0
@export var power_draw: float = 30.0
@export var can_accept_wires: bool = true
@export var build_time: float = 10.0
@export var fix_time: float = 4.0

var is_powered: bool = false
var is_broken: bool = false
var is_constructing: bool = false
var build_progress: float = 0.0
var fix_progress: float = 0.0
var progress_bar: ProgressBar = null

var connected_wires: Array = []
var base_visual_color: Color = Color.WHITE
var flash_time: float = 0.0
var _spark_timer: float = 0.0
var _repair_bar: Node2D = null

@onready var visual_rect: ColorRect = get_node_or_null("Visual")

func _ready() -> void:
	var old_sprite := get_node_or_null("Sprite2D") as CanvasItem
	if old_sprite != null:
		old_sprite.visible = false
	if visual_rect != null:
		visual_rect.visible = false
	var art := ModuleArt.new()
	art.name = "ModuleArt"
	add_child(art)
	move_child(art, 0)
	if visual_rect != null:
		base_visual_color = visual_rect.color
	if has_meta("is_ghost") and bool(get_meta("is_ghost")):
		return
	add_to_group("modules")
	face_reactor.call_deferred()
	if not is_constructing and get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		if not BaseManager.active_modules.has(self):
			BaseManager.active_modules.append(self)
		BaseManager.calculate_power()
	visible = true
	_update_visual_state(0.0)

func get_center() -> Vector2:
	var col := get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	if col != null:
		return global_position + col.position
	return global_position

func get_half_size() -> Vector2:
	var col := get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	if col != null and col.shape is RectangleShape2D:
		return (col.shape as RectangleShape2D).size * 0.5
	return Vector2(64, 64)

func get_footprint() -> Rect2:
	var half := get_half_size()
	return Rect2(get_center() - half, half * 2.0)

func interact_radius() -> float:
	return get_half_size().length() + ZONE_PAD

func start_construction() -> void:
	is_constructing = true
	visible = true   # stays visible: ModuleArt draws the blueprint scaffold while building
	is_powered = false
	build_progress = 0.0
	if visual_rect != null:
		visual_rect.modulate.a = 0.4

	if progress_bar == null:
		progress_bar = ProgressBar.new()
		progress_bar.max_value = 100.0
		progress_bar.value = 0.0
		progress_bar.size = Vector2(90, 14)
		progress_bar.position = Vector2(get_half_size().x - 45.0, -24.0)
		add_child(progress_bar)

func _finish_build() -> void:
	is_constructing = false
	visible = true
	build_progress = 100.0
	if visual_rect != null:
		visual_rect.modulate.a = 1.0
	if progress_bar != null:
		progress_bar.queue_free()
		progress_bar = null
	if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		if not BaseManager.active_modules.has(self):
			BaseManager.active_modules.append(self)
		BaseManager.calculate_power()
	EventBus.module_built.emit(self)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if has_meta("is_ghost") and bool(get_meta("is_ghost")):
		return

	_update_visual_state(delta)

	var player: Node2D = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player") as Node2D
	if is_constructing:
		if player != null and get_center().distance_to(player.global_position) <= interact_radius():
			build_progress = minf(100.0, build_progress + (100.0 / maxf(build_time, 0.1)) * delta)
			if progress_bar != null:
				progress_bar.value = build_progress
			if build_progress >= 100.0:
				_finish_build()
		return

	if is_broken:
		_tick_sparks(delta)
		if _repair_bar == null or not is_instance_valid(_repair_bar):
			_repair_bar = RepairBar.new()
			_repair_bar.set("host", self)
			add_child(_repair_bar)
	if is_broken and player != null:
		var in_reach := get_center().distance_to(player.global_position) <= interact_radius()
		var holding_e := Input.is_action_pressed("interact") or Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_E)
		if in_reach and holding_e:
			fix_progress = minf(100.0, fix_progress + (100.0 / maxf(fix_time, 0.1)) * delta)
			if fix_progress >= 100.0:
				repair_module()
		else:
			fix_progress = maxf(0.0, fix_progress - 40.0 * delta)

func get_connected_solar_count() -> int:
	if is_broken or is_constructing:
		return 0
	var solar_panels: Array[BaseModule] = []
	for w in connected_wires:
		if is_instance_valid(w) and "source_module" in w and is_instance_valid(w.source_module):
			var src: BaseModule = w.source_module
			if src.module_name == "Solar Panel" and not src.is_broken and not src.is_constructing:
				if not solar_panels.has(src):
					solar_panels.append(src)
	return solar_panels.size()

func is_fed_by_solar() -> bool:
	return get_connected_solar_count() > 0

func is_fed_by_reactor() -> bool:
	if is_broken or is_constructing:
		return false
	for w in connected_wires:
		if is_instance_valid(w) and "source_module" in w and is_instance_valid(w.source_module):
			var src: BaseModule = w.source_module
			if src.module_name == "Reactor" and src.is_powered and not src.is_broken and not src.is_constructing:
				return true
	return false

func has_failure_immunity() -> bool:
	if module_name == "Reactor" or module_name == "Solar Panel":
		return true
	return is_fed_by_solar()

func accept_wire(wire_node: Node2D) -> void:
	if not can_accept_wires or is_broken or is_constructing:
		return
	if not connected_wires.has(wire_node):
		connected_wires.append(wire_node)
	if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		BaseManager.calculate_power()

func remove_wire(wire_node: Node2D) -> void:
	connected_wires.erase(wire_node)
	if connected_wires.is_empty():
		is_powered = false
	if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		BaseManager.calculate_power()

func break_module() -> void:
	if has_failure_immunity() or is_broken or is_constructing:
		return
	is_broken = true
	is_powered = false
	fix_progress = 0.0

	if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		BaseManager.calculate_power()
	if get_node_or_null("/root/EventBus") != null:
		EventBus.module_broken.emit(module_name)

func repair_module() -> void:
	if not is_broken:
		return
	is_broken = false
	fix_progress = 0.0
	if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		BaseManager.calculate_power()

func _update_visual_state(delta: float) -> void:
	if visual_rect == null:
		return
	flash_time += delta
	if is_broken:
		var pulse: float = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(flash_time * 10.0)
		visual_rect.color = base_visual_color.darkened(0.65).lerp(Color(1.0, 0.1, 0.1), pulse)
	elif is_powered:
		var glow: float = 0.06 * sin(flash_time * 4.0)
		visual_rect.color = base_visual_color.lightened(glow)
	else:
		visual_rect.color = base_visual_color.darkened(0.55)

func face_reactor() -> void:
	if module_name == "Reactor":
		return
	var reactor: BaseModule = null
	for m in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("modules"):
		if m is BaseModule and (m as BaseModule).module_name == "Reactor":
			reactor = m as BaseModule
			break
	if reactor == null:
		return
	var d := reactor.get_center() - get_center()
	var s := 0
	if absf(d.x) > absf(d.y):
		s = 0 if d.x > 0.0 else 2
	else:
		s = 1 if d.y > 0.0 else 3
	var dirs: Array[Vector2] = [Vector2.RIGHT, Vector2.DOWN, Vector2.LEFT, Vector2.UP]
	var dir: Vector2 = dirs[s]
	var half := get_half_size()
	var edge := half.x if dir.x != 0.0 else half.y
	var col := get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	var ctr := col.position if col != null else half
	var target_rot := float(s) * PI * 0.5
	if module_name == "Solar Panel":
		var art := get_node_or_null("ModuleArt") as Node2D
		if art != null:
			# Rotate the art about its center; preserve its original collision footprint.
			art.rotation = target_rot
			art.scale = Vector2.ONE if s % 2 == 0 else Vector2(half.y / half.x, half.x / half.y)
			art.position = ctr - art.transform.basis_xform(ctr)
	# Solar outputs use the same edge-facing rule as module receivers.
	for c in get_children():
		if c is WireReceiver or (module_name == "Solar Panel" and c.has_method("spawn_wire")):
			var r := c as Node2D
			var rot := r.rotation + angle_difference(r.rotation, target_rot)
			var tw := create_tween().set_parallel(true)
			tw.tween_property(r, "position", ctr + dir * edge, 0.4).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
			tw.tween_property(r, "rotation", rot, 0.4).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


## Real sparks: little bright particles that fly OUT of the module, arc and fall.
func _tick_sparks(delta: float) -> void:
	_spark_timer -= delta
	if _spark_timer > 0.0:
		return
	_spark_timer = randf_range(0.25, 0.9)
	var fp := get_footprint()
	var pos := Vector2(randf_range(fp.position.x, fp.end.x), randf_range(fp.position.y, fp.end.y))
	var big := randf() < 0.25
	var p := CPUParticles2D.new()
	p.one_shot = true
	p.explosiveness = 1.0
	p.amount = 22 if big else 10
	p.lifetime = 0.8
	p.local_coords = false
	p.spread = 180.0
	p.initial_velocity_min = 90.0
	p.initial_velocity_max = 380.0 if big else 260.0
	p.gravity = Vector2(0, 700)
	p.damping_min = 20.0
	p.damping_max = 60.0
	p.scale_amount_min = 0.05
	p.scale_amount_max = 0.11
	p.color = Color(3.0, 2.0, 0.7, 1.0)
	p.z_index = 80
	var g := Gradient.new()
	g.set_color(0, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
	g.set_color(1, Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.1, 0.0))
	p.color_ramp = g
	var tex := GradientTexture2D.new()
	var tg := Gradient.new()
	tg.set_color(0, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
	tg.set_color(1, Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
	tex.gradient = tg
	tex.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_RADIAL
	tex.fill_from = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
	tex.fill_to = Vector2(1.0, 0.5)
	tex.width = 32
	tex.height = 32
	p.texture = tex
	var mat := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
	mat.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	p.material = mat
	get_parent().add_child(p)
	p.global_position = pos
	p.emitting = true
	get_tree().create_timer(1.4).timeout.connect(p.queue_free)

## Progress bar above a broken module (fills while you hold E).
class RepairBar extends Node2D:
	var host: BaseModule
	var shown := 0.0
	var vis := 0.0
	var t := 0.0
	func _ready() -> void:
		top_level = true
		z_as_relative = false
		z_index = 250
	func _process(d: float) -> void:
		if host == null or not is_instance_valid(host) or not host.is_broken:
			queue_free()
			return
		t += d
		shown = lerpf(shown, host.fix_progress / 100.0, 1.0 - exp(-14.0 * d))
		vis = lerpf(vis, 1.0, 1.0 - exp(-8.0 * d))
		global_position = host.get_center() + Vector2(0.0, -host.get_half_size().length() - 34.0)
		global_rotation = 0.0
		queue_redraw()
	func _draw() -> void:
		if host == null or not is_instance_valid(host):
			return
		var w := 150.0
		var h := 16.0
		var a := vis
		var holding := host.fix_progress > 0.5
		draw_rect(Rect2(-w * 0.5 - 4.0, -h * 0.5 - 4.0, w + 8.0, h + 8.0), Color(0.04, 0.05, 0.09, 0.9 * a))
		var col := Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.2).lerp(Color(0.4, 1.0, 0.55), shown)
		draw_rect(Rect2(-w * 0.5, -h * 0.5, w, h), Color(0.15, 0.17, 0.25, a))
		if shown > 0.005:
			draw_rect(Rect2(-w * 0.5, -h * 0.5, w * shown, h), Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, a))
			draw_rect(Rect2(-w * 0.5 + w * shown - 2.0, -h * 0.5, 2.0, h), Color(1, 1, 1, a))
		var f := ThemeDB.fallback_font
		var txt := "Fixing...  %d%%" % int(shown * 100.0) if holding else "Hold E to fix"
		var tw := f.get_string_size(txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 17).x
		var pulse := 1.0 if holding else 0.65 + 0.35 * sin(t * 6.0)
		draw_string(f, Vector2(-tw * 0.5, -h * 0.5 - 10.0), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 17, Color(1, 0.95, 0.8, a * pulse))

class_name SaveFlags
## Tiny save file for "has the player finished X" flags.
const PATH := "user://flags.cfg"

static func get_flag(key: String) -> bool:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	if cfg.load(PATH) != OK:
		return false
	return bool(cfg.get_value("flags", key, false))

static func set_flag(key: String, value: bool = true) -> void:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	cfg.load(PATH)
	cfg.set_value("flags", key, value)
	cfg.save(PATH)

class_name SynthSfx
## Generated sounds so the hazards work without any audio files.

static func _wav(samples: PackedFloat32Array, rate: int, loop: bool = false) -> AudioStreamWAV:
	var data := PackedByteArray()
	data.resize(samples.size() * 2)
	for i in samples.size():
		var pcm := int(clampf(samples[i], -1.0, 1.0) * 32767.0)
		data[i * 2] = pcm & 0xFF
		data[i * 2 + 1] = (pcm >> 8) & 0xFF
	var w := AudioStreamWAV.new()
	w.format = AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS
	w.mix_rate = rate
	w.stereo = false
	w.data = data
	if loop:
		w.loop_mode = AudioStreamWAV.LOOP_FORWARD
		w.loop_begin = 0
		w.loop_end = samples.size()
	return w

static func crash_wav() -> AudioStreamWAV:
	var rate := 22050
	var n := int(rate * 2.4)
	var s := PackedFloat32Array()
	s.resize(n)
	var lp := 0.0
	var ph := 0.0
	for i in n:
		var t := float(i) / rate
		var env := exp(-t * 2.2)
		var punch := exp(-t * 18.0)
		ph += TAU * lerpf(95.0, 28.0, clampf(t / 0.8, 0.0, 1.0)) / rate
		var boom := sin(ph) * punch * 0.9
		var raw := randf_range(-1.0, 1.0)
		lp += 0.14 * (raw - lp)
		var crunch := sin(t * 420.0 + raw * 3.5) * exp(-t * 6.5) * 0.35
		s[i] = lp * 1.3 * env + boom + crunch
	return _wav(s, rate)

## Seamless low howl with slow gusts. Loop it.
static func wind_wav() -> AudioStreamWAV:
	var rate := 22050
	var n := rate * 6
	var s := PackedFloat32Array()
	s.resize(n)
	var lp1 := 0.0
	var lp2 := 0.0
	for i in n:
		var t := float(i) / rate
		var raw := randf_range(-1.0, 1.0)
		lp1 += 0.05 * (raw - lp1)
		lp2 += 0.35 * (raw - lp2)
		var gust := 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(t * TAU / 6.0) * sin(t * TAU / 3.0 + 1.0)
		s[i] = (lp1 * 2.6 + (lp2 - lp1) * 0.5) * gust * 0.8
	var fade := int(rate * 0.25)
	for i in fade:
		var k := float(i) / fade
		s[n - fade + i] = lerpf(s[n - fade + i], s[i], k)
	return _wav(s, rate, true)

## Rising roar, then a heavy hit.
static func flare_wav() -> AudioStreamWAV:
	var rate := 22050
	var n := int(rate * 3.2)
	var s := PackedFloat32Array()
	s.resize(n)
	var lp := 0.0
	var ph := 0.0
	for i in n:
		var t := float(i) / rate
		var raw := randf_range(-1.0, 1.0)
		lp += lerpf(0.04, 0.5, clampf(t / 0.9, 0.0, 1.0)) * (raw - lp)
		var rise := smoothstep(0.0, 0.9, t) * (1.0 if t < 0.9 else exp(-(t - 0.9) * 1.4))
		ph += TAU * lerpf(70.0, 32.0, clampf((t - 0.9) / 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)) / rate
		var hit := sin(ph) * (exp(-(t - 0.9) * 3.0) if t >= 0.9 else 0.0)
		s[i] = lp * rise * 1.2 + hit * 0.85
	return _wav(s, rate)

static func beep_wav() -> AudioStreamWAV:
	var rate := 22050
	var n := int(rate * 0.16)
	var s := PackedFloat32Array()
	s.resize(n)
	for i in n:
		var t := float(i) / rate
		s[i] = sin(t * TAU * 880.0) * exp(-t * 14.0) * 0.6
	return _wav(s, rate)

	bg_rect = ColorRect.new()
	bg_rect.color = Color.BLACK
	bg_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	bg_rect.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	add_child(bg_rect)

	flash_rect = ColorRect.new()
	flash_rect.color = Color(1.0, 0.25, 0.1, 0.0)
	flash_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	flash_rect.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	add_child(flash_rect)

	log_label = Label.new()
	log_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var ls := LabelSettings.new()
	ls.font = font
	ls.font_color = terminal_color
	ls.font_size = 20
	ls.line_spacing = 6.0
	log_label.label_settings = ls
	log_label.position = base_label_pos
	log_label.size = get_viewport_rect().size - Vector2(144, 180)
	log_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	add_child(log_label)

	prompt_label = Label.new()
	prompt_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var pls := LabelSettings.new()
	pls.font = font
	pls.font_color = terminal_color.lightened(0.25)
	pls.font_size = 22
	prompt_label.label_settings = pls
	prompt_label.text = ""
	prompt_label.position = Vector2(72, get_viewport_rect().size.y - 80)
	prompt_label.visible = false
	add_child(prompt_label)

	skip_warn_label = Label.new()
	skip_warn_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var swls := LabelSettings.new()
	swls.font = font
	swls.font_color = Color(1.0, 0.78, 0.28)
	swls.font_size = 15
	skip_warn_label.label_settings = swls
	skip_warn_label.text = "[ PRESS ANY BUTTON AGAIN TO SKIP ]"
	skip_warn_label.modulate.a = 0.0
	add_child(skip_warn_label)

	get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_on_viewport_resized)
	_on_viewport_resized()

	_setup_audio()
	
	is_waiting_for_start = true
	_wait_and_start_crash()

func _wait_and_start_crash() -> void:
	var time_remaining = start_delay
	while time_remaining > 0.0 and is_waiting_for_start and is_inside_tree():
		await get_tree().process_frame
		time_remaining -= get_process_delta_time()
	
	if is_waiting_for_start and is_inside_tree():
		is_waiting_for_start = false
		_run_crash_sequence()

func _on_viewport_resized() -> void:
	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport_rect().size
	log_label.size = vp_size - Vector2(144, 180)
	prompt_label.position = Vector2(72, vp_size.y - 80)
	_layout_choice()
	if skip_warn_label != null:
		skip_warn_label.position = vp_size - skip_warn_label.size - Vector2(36, 28)

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if transitioning_out or choosing or skip_cooldown > 0.0:
		return
	var pressed: bool = false
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		pressed = true
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		pressed = true
	elif event is InputEventJoypadButton and event.pressed:
		pressed = true
	if not pressed:
		return
	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	if is_waiting_for_start:
		is_waiting_for_start = false
		_run_crash_sequence()
		return
	# pressing twice while the log types jumps straight to the question
	if skip_armed_timer > 0.0:
		skip_requested = true
		skip_armed_timer = 0.0
	else:
		skip_armed_timer = 3.5
		skip_cooldown = 0.18
		if typing_player != null:
			typing_player.pitch_scale = 0.8
			typing_player.play()

func _proceed_to_target_scene(scene_path: String = "") -> void:
	var dest := scene_path if scene_path != "" else target_scene
	if transitioning_out:
		return
	transitioning_out = true
	is_typing = false
	skip_armed_timer = 0.0

	if typing_player != null:
		typing_player.pitch_scale = 1.35
		typing_player.play()

	if crash_player != null and crash_player.playing:
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_property(crash_player, "volume_db", -60.0, fade_out_duration * 0.8)

	var trans = get_node_or_null("/root/Transition")
	if trans != null:
		while "transitioning" in trans and trans.transitioning:
			if not is_inside_tree():
				return
			await get_tree().process_frame
		trans.change_scene(dest, fade_out_duration)
	else:
		get_tree().change_scene_to_file(dest)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	time_elapsed += delta
	if skip_cooldown > 0.0:
		skip_cooldown = maxf(0.0, skip_cooldown - delta)

	if shake_strength > 0.0:
		shake_strength = maxf(0.0, shake_strength - delta * 28.0)
		var offset := Vector2(
			randf_range(-shake_strength, shake_strength),
			randf_range(-shake_strength, shake_strength)
		)
		log_label.position = base_label_pos + offset
	else:
		log_label.position = base_label_pos

	var cursor: String = "\u2588" if int(time_elapsed * 3.0) % 2 == 0 else " "
	log_label.text = full_displayed_text + cursor

	if false and prompt_label != null:
		prompt_label.modulate.a = 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(time_elapsed * 5.0)

	if skip_warn_label != null:
		var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport_rect().size
		skip_warn_label.position = vp_size - skip_warn_label.size - Vector2(36, 28)
		if skip_armed_timer > 0.0 and not choosing and not transitioning_out:
			skip_armed_timer = maxf(0.0, skip_armed_timer - delta)
			var pulse_a: float = 0.7 + 0.3 * sin(time_elapsed * 8.0) if skip_armed_timer > 0.5 else (skip_armed_timer / 0.5) * 0.8
			skip_warn_label.modulate.a = lerpf(skip_warn_label.modulate.a, pulse_a, delta * 14.0)
		else:
			skip_warn_label.modulate.a = lerpf(skip_warn_label.modulate.a, 0.0, delta * 10.0)

func _setup_audio() -> void:
	crash_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	crash_player.volume_db = crash_volume_db
	crash_player.stream = crash_sfx if crash_sfx != null else _generate_crash_wav()
	add_child(crash_player)

	typing_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	typing_player.volume_db = typing_volume_db
	typing_player.stream = typing_sfx if typing_sfx != null else _generate_type_click_wav()
	add_child(typing_player)

func _run_crash_sequence() -> void:
	skip_cooldown = 0.18
	crash_player.play()
	shake_strength = 22.0
	flash_rect.color = Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.1, 0.55)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(flash_rect, "color:a", 0.0, 1.4)

	await get_tree().create_timer(1.4).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree() or transitioning_out:
		return

	is_typing = true
	for line_idx in range(log_lines.size()):
		if skip_requested:
			break
		if transitioning_out or not is_inside_tree():
			return
		var line: String = log_lines[line_idx]
		if line == "":
			full_displayed_text += "\n"
			await get_tree().create_timer(line_pause * 0.6).timeout
			continue
		for i in range(line.length()):
			if skip_requested or transitioning_out or not is_inside_tree():
				break
			var ch: String = line.substr(i, 1)
			full_displayed_text += ch
			if ch != " ":
				typing_player.pitch_scale = randf_range(0.92, 1.12)
				typing_player.play()
			await get_tree().create_timer(char_delay).timeout
		if skip_requested:
			break
		full_displayed_text += "\n"
		if line_idx == 3:
			crash_player.pitch_scale = 0.75
			crash_player.volume_db = crash_volume_db - 4.0
			crash_player.play()
			shake_strength = 14.0
		await get_tree().create_timer(line_pause).timeout
	if transitioning_out or not is_inside_tree():
		return
	if skip_requested:
		full_displayed_text = "\n".join(log_lines) + "\n"
	is_typing = false
	skip_armed_timer = 0.0
	_show_choice()

func _show_choice() -> void:
	choosing = true
	choice_box = HBoxContainer.new()
	choice_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 22)
	choice_box.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_BEGIN
	add_child(choice_box)
	var yes := _choice_button("YES, SHOW ME")
	var no := _choice_button("NO, LET ME IN")
	yes.pressed.connect(_choose.bind(tutorial_scene))
	no.pressed.connect(_choose.bind(target_scene))
	choice_hint = Label.new()
	choice_hint.text = "A / D or arrow keys to choose  -  ENTER or click to confirm"
	choice_hint.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	choice_hint.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	choice_hint.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.5, 0.75, 0.7))
	add_child(choice_hint)
	_layout_choice()
	yes.grab_focus()

func _choice_button(text: String) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.text = text
	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(250, 48)
	b.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	GlassUI.style_button(b, 20)
	choice_box.add_child(b)
	return b

func _layout_choice() -> void:
	if choice_box == null:
		return
	var vp := get_viewport_rect().size
	choice_box.position = Vector2(72, vp.y - 120)
	choice_hint.position = Vector2(72, vp.y - 52)

func _choose(path: String) -> void:
	if transitioning_out:
		return
	choosing = false
	for c in choice_box.get_children():
		(c as Button).disabled = true
	_proceed_to_target_scene(path)

func _generate_crash_wav() -> AudioStreamWAV:
	var mix_rate: int = 22050
	var duration: float = 2.4
	var samples: int = int(mix_rate * duration)
	var data := PackedByteArray()
	data.resize(samples * 2)

	var low_pass: float = 0.0
	var sub_phase: float = 0.0

	for i in range(samples):
		var t: float = float(i) / float(mix_rate)
		var env: float = exp(-t * 2.2)
		var impact_punch: float = exp(-t * 18.0)

		sub_phase += TAU * lerpf(95.0, 28.0, clampf(t / 0.8, 0.0, 1.0)) / float(mix_rate)
		var sub_boom: float = sin(sub_phase) * impact_punch * 0.9

		var raw_noise: float = randf_range(-1.0, 1.0)
		low_pass = low_pass + 0.14 * (raw_noise - low_pass)
		var metal_crunch: float = sin(t * 420.0 + raw_noise * 3.5) * exp(-t * 6.5) * 0.35

		var sample: float = clampf((low_pass * 1.3 * env) + sub_boom + metal_crunch, -1.0, 1.0)
		var pcm: int = int(sample * 32767.0)
		data[i * 2] = pcm & 0xFF
		data[i * 2 + 1] = (pcm >> 8) & 0xFF

	var wav := AudioStreamWAV.new()
	wav.format = AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS
	wav.mix_rate = mix_rate
	wav.stereo = false
	wav.data = data
	return wav

func _generate_type_click_wav() -> AudioStreamWAV:
	var mix_rate: int = 22050
	var duration: float = 0.028
	var samples: int = int(mix_rate * duration)
	var data := PackedByteArray()
	data.resize(samples * 2)

	for i in range(samples):
		var t: float = float(i) / float(mix_rate)
		var env: float = exp(-t * 170.0)
		var tone: float = sin(t * TAU * 1450.0) * 0.65 + sin(t * TAU * 2900.0) * 0.35
		var click: float = (tone + randf_range(-0.35, 0.35)) * env
		var pcm: int = int(clampf(click, -1.0, 1.0) * 32767.0)
		data[i * 2] = pcm & 0xFF
		data[i * 2 + 1] = (pcm >> 8) & 0xFF

	var wav := AudioStreamWAV.new()
	wav.format = AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS
	wav.mix_rate = mix_rate
	wav.stereo = false
	wav.data = data
	return wav

const BG_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform float time = 0.0;
uniform float aspect = 1.7778;
uniform vec2 lens_center = vec2(2.67, 0.5);
uniform float lens_radius = 3.0;
uniform float lens_strength = 0.85;
uniform vec4 nebula_a : source_color = vec4(0.05, 0.02, 0.12, 1.0);
uniform vec4 nebula_b : source_color = vec4(0.12, 0.02, 0.06, 1.0);
uniform vec4 star_col : source_color = vec4(0.88, 0.94, 1.0, 1.0);

float hash21(vec2 p) {
	vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
	p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);
	return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
}
float noise(vec2 p) {
	vec2 i = floor(p);
	vec2 f = fract(p);
	vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
	return mix(mix(hash21(i), hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), u.x),
	           mix(hash21(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), u.x), u.y);
}
float fbm(vec2 p) {
	float v = 0.0;
	float a = 0.5;
	for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { v += a * noise(p); p = p * 2.03 + vec2(1.7, 9.2); a *= 0.5; }
	return v;
}

vec3 star_layer(vec2 sp, float scale, float density, float size, float seed, float spikes) {
	vec2 g = sp * scale;
	vec2 id = floor(g);
	vec2 f = fract(g) - 0.5;
	float h = hash21(id + seed);
	if (h < density) { return vec3(0.0); }
	float k = (h - density) / (1.0 - density);
	vec2 off = (vec2(hash21(id + seed + 3.1), hash21(id + seed + 7.7)) - 0.5) * 0.6;
	vec2 d = f - off;
	float r = length(d);
	float tw = 0.65 + 0.35 * sin(time * (1.0 + k * 3.0) + k * 40.0);
	float core = smoothstep(size, 0.0, r) * tw;
	float halo = smoothstep(size * 5.0, 0.0, r) * 0.12;
	float cross = (smoothstep(0.012, 0.0, abs(d.y)) * smoothstep(0.45, 0.0, abs(d.x))
	             + smoothstep(0.012, 0.0, abs(d.x)) * smoothstep(0.45, 0.0, abs(d.y))) * spikes * k;
	float temp = hash21(id + seed + 11.3);
	vec3 tint = mix(vec3(0.62, 0.78, 1.0), vec3(1.0, 0.94, 0.86), smoothstep(0.0, 0.6, temp));
	tint = mix(tint, vec3(1.0, 0.62, 0.35), smoothstep(0.75, 1.0, temp));
	tint = mix(tint, star_col.rgb, 0.25);
	return tint * (core * (0.8 + 2.0 * k) + halo + cross * 0.6);
}

void fragment() {
	vec2 p = vec2(UV.x * aspect, UV.y);

	vec2 d = p - lens_center;
	float r = max(length(d), 0.0001);
	float R = lens_radius;
	float src = r - lens_strength * R * R / r;
	vec2 sp = lens_center + (d / r) * src;
	float x = r / R;
	float mag = 1.0 + 0.9 * lens_strength * exp(-(x - 1.0) * 7.0) * step(1.0, x + 0.15);

	vec2 np = sp * 0.9;
	float n1 = fbm(np + vec2(time * 0.004, time * 0.002));
	float n2 = fbm(np * 1.7 + vec2(-time * 0.006, time * 0.003) + vec2(3.7, 1.2));
	float dust = 1.0 - abs(fbm(np * 2.3 + 8.0) * 2.0 - 1.0);
	vec3 col = mix(nebula_a.rgb, nebula_b.rgb, n1 * n2);
	col *= (n1 * 0.55 + 0.10);
	col *= mix(1.0, 0.35, pow(dust, 4.0));
	float band = exp(-pow(dot(sp - vec2(1.2, 0.5), normalize(vec2(0.45, 1.0))) * 1.9, 2.0));
	col += mix(nebula_a.rgb, vec3(0.5, 0.3, 0.4), 0.5) * band * (0.25 + 0.5 * n2) * 0.7;

	vec3 st = vec3(0.0);
	st += star_layer(sp, 70.0, 0.955, 0.10, 1.0, 0.0);
	st += star_layer(sp, 130.0, 0.965, 0.085, 13.7, 0.0) * 0.9;
	st += star_layer(sp, 230.0, 0.975, 0.075, 29.1, 0.0) * 0.8;
	st += star_layer(sp, 28.0, 0.985, 0.06, 57.3, 1.0) * 1.8;
	col += st * (band * 1.6 + 1.0) * mag;

	COLOR = vec4(col, 1.0);
}
"""

const MARS_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform float time = 0.0;
uniform float rotation_speed = 0.025;
uniform vec2 light_dir = vec2(0.85, -0.35);
uniform float breath = 0.0;

float hash21(vec2 p) {
	vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
	p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);
	return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
}
float noise(vec2 p) {
	vec2 i = floor(p);
	vec2 f = fract(p);
	vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
	return mix(mix(hash21(i), hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), u.x),
	           mix(hash21(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), u.x), u.y);
}
float fbm(vec2 p) {
	float v = 0.0;
	float a = 0.5;
	for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
		v += a * noise(p);
		p = p * 2.03 + vec2(2.3, 5.7);
		a *= 0.5;
	}
	return v;
}

void fragment() {
	vec2 uv = (UV - 0.5) * 2.4;
	float r = length(uv);
	if (r > 1.2) { discard; }

	vec2 L2 = normalize(light_dir + vec2(0.0001));
	vec3 L = normalize(vec3(L2, 0.35));

	float atmo_halo = exp(-max(r - 0.98, 0.0) * 14.0) * smoothstep(1.2, 0.98, r);
	float sun_side = clamp(dot(normalize(uv + vec2(0.0001)), L2) * 0.6 + 0.4, 0.0, 1.0);

	if (r > 1.0) {
		vec3 halo_col = vec3(1.0, 0.48, 0.22) * atmo_halo * sun_side * (0.65 + 0.2 * breath);
		COLOR = vec4(halo_col, atmo_halo * sun_side * 0.75);
	} else {
		float z = sqrt(max(1.0 - r * r, 0.0));
		vec3 N = normalize(vec3(uv, z));

		float lat = asin(clamp(uv.y, -0.999, 0.999));
		float lon = atan(uv.x, max(z, 0.0001)) - time * rotation_speed;
		vec2 S = vec2(lon * cos(lat), lat);

		float n1 = fbm(S * 2.6 + vec2(1.4, 3.2));
		float n2 = fbm(S * 6.5 - vec2(2.1, 0.8) + n1 * 0.45);
		float n3 = fbm(S * 16.0 + n2 * 0.35);
		float ridge = 1.0 - abs(fbm(S * 5.0 + 4.0) * 2.0 - 1.0);

		vec3 dark_rock = vec3(0.32, 0.12, 0.07);
		vec3 mid_rust = vec3(0.76, 0.29, 0.13);
		vec3 bright_ochre = vec3(0.95, 0.52, 0.26);

		vec3 albedo = mix(dark_rock, mid_rust, smoothstep(0.28, 0.62, n1));
		albedo = mix(albedo, bright_ochre, smoothstep(0.52, 0.85, n2) * 0.75);
		albedo *= 0.82 + 0.32 * n3;
		albedo = mix(albedo, vec3(0.22, 0.08, 0.05), pow(ridge, 6.0) * 0.45);

		float pole = smoothstep(0.78, 0.95, abs(uv.y) + (n2 - 0.5) * 0.12);
		albedo = mix(albedo, vec3(0.92, 0.84, 0.78), pole * 0.65);

		vec3 N_bump = normalize(N + vec3((n2 - 0.5) * 0.18, (n3 - 0.5) * 0.18, 0.0));
		float ndl = clamp(dot(N_bump, L), 0.0, 1.0);
		float terminator = smoothstep(-0.12, 0.25, dot(N, L));

		vec3 ambient = vec3(0.08, 0.03, 0.04);
		vec3 surface = albedo * (ambient + vec3(1.05, 0.88, 0.72) * pow(ndl, 0.85) * 1.25 * terminator);

		float rim = pow(1.0 - z, 2.6);
		vec3 atmo_col = mix(vec3(0.85, 0.32, 0.14), vec3(1.0, 0.68, 0.38), sun_side);
		surface = mix(surface, atmo_col, rim * (0.35 + 0.50 * sun_side));
		surface += atmo_col * rim * sun_side * (0.35 + 0.15 * breath);

		float edge_aa = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.985, 1.0, r);
		vec3 halo_col = vec3(1.0, 0.48, 0.22) * atmo_halo * sun_side * 0.5;
		vec3 final_col = mix(halo_col, surface, edge_aa);
		float final_alpha = max(edge_aa, atmo_halo * sun_side * 0.75);

		COLOR = vec4(final_col, final_alpha);
	}
}
"""

const SUN_INNER_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform float time = 0.0;
uniform float rotation_speed = 0.012;
uniform vec2 sun_aspect = vec2(1.0, 1.0);
uniform vec4 core_col : source_color = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 0.98, 1.0);
uniform vec4 mid_col : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.85, 0.40, 1.0);
uniform vec4 edge_col : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.58, 0.15, 1.0);
uniform float breath = 0.0;
uniform float breath_phase = 0.0;
uniform float tension = 0.0;
uniform float ring_strength = 0.9;
uniform vec4 spot_a = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
uniform vec4 spot_b = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
uniform vec4 flare_a = vec4(0.0, 0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
uniform vec4 flare_b = vec4(0.0, 0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
uniform vec4 flare_c = vec4(0.0, 0.0, -1.0, 0.0);

vec2 hash22(vec2 p) {
	vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * vec3(0.1031, 0.1030, 0.0973));
	p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);
	return fract((p3.xx + p3.yz) * p3.zy);
}
float hash21(vec2 p) {
	vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
	p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);
	return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
}
float noise(vec2 p) {
	vec2 i = floor(p);
	vec2 f = fract(p);
	vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
	return mix(mix(hash21(i), hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), u.x),
	           mix(hash21(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), u.x), u.y);
}
float fbm(vec2 p) {
	float v = 0.0;
	float a = 0.5;
	for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { v += a * noise(p); p = p * 2.03 + vec2(3.1, 7.3); a *= 0.5; }
	return v;
}
vec3 voro(vec2 p, float t) {
	vec2 n = floor(p);
	vec2 f = fract(p);
	float d1 = 8.0;
	float d2 = 8.0;
	float id = 0.0;
	for (int j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
		for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
			vec2 g = vec2(float(i), float(j));
			vec2 h = hash22(n + g);
			vec2 o = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t + 6.2831 * h);
			vec2 r = g + o - f;
			float d = dot(r, r);
			if (d < d1) { d2 = d1; d1 = d; id = h.x; }
			else if (d < d2) { d2 = d; }
		}
	}
	return vec3(sqrt(d1), sqrt(d2), id);
}
vec3 aces(vec3 x) {
	return clamp((x * (2.51 * x + 0.03)) / (x * (2.43 * x + 0.59) + 0.14), 0.0, 1.0);
}
vec2 sunspot(vec2 S, vec2 c, float r, float seed) {
	vec2 d = S - c;
	float dl = length(d);
	if (dl > r * 2.6) { return vec2(0.0); }
	float ang = atan(d.y, d.x);
	float w = fbm(S * 9.0 / max(r, 0.01) * 0.12 + seed) - 0.5;
	float dd = dl + w * r * 0.55;
	float fil = fbm(vec2(ang * 5.0 + seed, dl / r * 3.0 - time * 0.05));
	float umbra = 1.0 - smoothstep(r * 0.55, r * 0.95, dd);
	float pen = (1.0 - smoothstep(r * 1.2, r * 2.15, dd + (fil - 0.5) * r * 0.5)) * (0.55 + 0.9 * fil);
	return vec2(umbra, clamp(pen, 0.0, 1.0));
}
float flare_burst(vec2 uv, vec4 f) {
	if (f.z < 0.0) { return 0.0; }
	float a = f.z;
	float d = length(uv - f.xy);
	float env = smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, a) * exp(-a * 0.55);
	float rad = 0.018 + a * 0.020;
	float blob = exp(-(d * d) / (rad * rad));
	float ring = exp(-pow((d - a * 0.075) / 0.008, 2.0));
	return (blob * 1.9 + ring * 0.5) * env * f.w;
}

void fragment() {
	vec2 uv = (UV - 0.5) * 2.0;
	uv.x /= sun_aspect.x;
	uv.y /= sun_aspect.y;

	float R = 1.0 - 0.011 * breath;
	float dist = length(uv) / R;
	if (dist > 1.0) { discard; }
	vec2 q = uv / R;
	float mu = sqrt(max(1.0 - dist * dist, 0.0));

	float lat = asin(clamp(q.y, -0.999, 0.999));
	float lon = atan(q.x, max(mu, 0.0001));
	lon -= time * rotation_speed * (1.0 - 0.28 * q.y * q.y);
	float swell = 1.0 - 0.012 * breath;
	vec2 S = vec2(lon * cos(lat), lat) * swell;
	float t = time;

	vec2 warp = vec2(fbm(S * 2.4 + vec2(t * 0.050, 0.0)), fbm(S * 2.4 + vec2(5.2, 1.3) - vec2(0.0, t * 0.040))) - 0.5;
	vec2 Sw = S + warp * 0.22;

	vec2 w2 = vec2(noise(Sw * 30.0 + t * 0.15), noise(Sw * 30.0 + 17.0 - t * 0.15)) - 0.5;
	vec3 g1 = voro(Sw * 4.0 + w2 * 0.25, t * 0.22);
	vec3 g2 = voro(Sw * 15.0 + 3.3 + w2 * 0.45, t * 0.45);
	vec3 g3 = voro(Sw * 44.0 + 9.1 + w2 * 0.8, t * 0.90);
	float lane1 = smoothstep(0.0, 0.45, g1.y - g1.x);
	float lane2 = pow(smoothstep(0.0, 0.34, g2.y - g2.x), 0.8);
	float lane3 = smoothstep(0.0, 0.30, g3.y - g3.x);
	float cen2 = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.80, g2.x);
	float cen3 = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.70, g3.x);

	float x = 0.35;
	x *= mix(0.60, 1.0, lane1) * (0.75 + 0.50 * g1.z);
	x *= mix(0.10 + 0.10 * (1.0 - breath), 1.0, lane2) * (0.55 + 0.90 * g2.z) * (0.65 + 0.70 * cen2);
	x *= mix(0.60, 1.0, lane3) * (0.85 + 0.30 * cen3);
	x *= 0.62 + 0.80 * fbm(Sw * 1.8 + 9.0);
	x += fbm(Sw * 90.0 + t * 0.3) * 0.08;
	x *= 1.45;

	float rv1 = 1.0 - abs(fbm(Sw * 4.2 + vec2(t * 0.035, -t * 0.028)) * 2.0 - 1.0);
	float rv2 = 1.0 - abs(fbm(Sw * 11.0 - vec2(t * 0.05, t * 0.03) + 4.0) * 2.0 - 1.0);
	float veins = (pow(rv1, 14.0) * 1.1 + pow(rv2, 18.0) * 0.6) * (1.0 - 0.7 * lane2);
	x += veins * (0.45 + 0.9 * breath + 0.7 * tension);

	vec2 sp1 = vec2(0.0);
	vec2 sp2 = vec2(0.0);
	if (spot_a.z > 0.0) {
		vec2 c = vec2(spot_a.x * cos(spot_a.y), spot_a.y);
		sp1 = sunspot(S, c, spot_a.z, 1.0);
		sp1 = max(sp1, sunspot(S, c + vec2(0.9, -0.55) * spot_a.z, spot_a.z * 0.38, 7.0));
		sp1 = max(sp1, sunspot(S, c + vec2(-0.8, 0.70) * spot_a.z, spot_a.z * 0.30, 11.0));
	}
	if (spot_b.z > 0.0) {
		vec2 c = vec2(spot_b.x * cos(spot_b.y), spot_b.y);
		sp2 = sunspot(S, c, spot_b.z, 3.0);
		sp2 = max(sp2, sunspot(S, c + vec2(-0.85, -0.6) * spot_b.z, spot_b.z * 0.35, 5.0));
	}
	vec2 sp = max(sp1, sp2);
	float umbral_dots = pow(noise(S * 120.0 + t * 0.4), 6.0) * 0.5;
	x *= 1.0 - sp.y * 0.55 * (1.0 - sp.x);
	x = mix(x, 0.07 + umbral_dots * 0.35, sp.x);
	float plage = smoothstep(0.0, 0.8, sp.y) * (1.0 - sp.x) * (1.0 - lane2) * 0.30;
	x += plage;

	float limb = mix(0.40, 1.0, pow(mu, 0.55));
	x *= limb;
	x += (1.0 - lane2) * (1.0 - mu) * (1.0 - mu) * 0.30 * fbm(Sw * 18.0);

	float wave = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(dist * 16.0 - breath_phase * 6.2831);
	x *= (0.80 + 0.36 * breath) * (1.0 + 0.09 * wave * (0.4 + breath));
	x *= 1.0 + 0.10 * tension;

	x += flare_burst(uv, flare_a) + flare_burst(uv, flare_b) + flare_burst(uv, flare_c);

	float doppler = 1.0 + 0.35 * q.x;
	float ring = smoothstep(0.955, 0.994, dist) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.994, 1.0, dist));
	x += ring * ring_strength * (0.9 + 0.9 * breath) * doppler;

	vec3 c1 = mix(edge_col.rgb * vec3(0.55, 0.12, 0.05), edge_col.rgb, smoothstep(0.0, 0.55, x));
	c1 = mix(c1, mid_col.rgb, smoothstep(0.50, 1.15, x));
	c1 = mix(c1, core_col.rgb, smoothstep(1.05, 1.90, x));
	vec3 col = c1 * (0.20 + 1.00 * x);
	col = aces(col * 1.05);
	col += (hash21(FRAGCOORD.xy + fract(time) * 91.0) - 0.5) / 255.0;

	float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.992, 1.0, dist);
	COLOR = vec4(col, alpha);
}
"""

const SUN_OUTER_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
render_mode blend_add;
uniform float time = 0.0;
uniform vec2 sun_aspect = vec2(1.0, 1.0);
uniform float outer_uv = 1.95;
uniform vec4 near_col : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.78, 0.32, 1.0);
uniform vec4 mid_col : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.48, 0.12, 1.0);
uniform vec4 far_col : source_color = vec4(0.95, 0.28, 0.06, 1.0);

float hash(vec2 p) { return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453); }
float noise(vec2 p) {
	vec2 i = floor(p);
	vec2 f = fract(p);
	vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
	return mix(mix(hash(i), hash(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), u.x),
	           mix(hash(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), hash(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), u.x), u.y);
}
float fbm(vec2 p) {
	float v = 0.0;
	float a = 0.5;
	for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { v += a * noise(p); p *= 2.0; a *= 0.5; }
	return v;
}

void fragment() {
	vec2 uv = (UV - 0.5) * 2.0;
	uv.x /= sun_aspect.x;
	uv.y /= sun_aspect.y;
	float dist = length(uv);
	if (dist < 0.85 || dist > outer_uv) { discard; }

	float angle = atan(-uv.y, -uv.x);
	float t = clamp(dist / outer_uv, 0.0, 1.0);

	float streak_a = fbm(vec2(angle * 7.0, t * 3.5 - time * 0.14));
	float streak_b = fbm(vec2(angle * 22.0, t * 8.0 - time * 0.30));
	float streak_c = fbm(vec2(angle * 48.0, t * 16.0 - time * 0.55));

	float streaks = streak_a * 0.50 + streak_b * 0.32 + streak_c * 0.18;
	streaks = smoothstep(0.25, 0.78, streaks);

	float fade = smoothstep(0.85, 1.05, dist) * (1.0 - smoothstep(1.0, outer_uv, dist));
	fade = pow(fade, 1.6);

	float intensity = fade * (streaks * 2.0 + 0.22);

	vec3 col;
	if (t < 0.35) {
		col = mix(near_col.rgb, mid_col.rgb, t / 0.35);
	} else {
		col = mix(mid_col.rgb, far_col.rgb, (t - 0.35) / 0.65);
	}

	float prom = fbm(vec2(angle * 2.5, t * 4.5 - time * 0.09));
	float prom_mask = smoothstep(0.55, 0.86, prom);
	float prom_band = smoothstep(1.1, 0.95, dist);
	col += near_col.rgb * prom_mask * prom_band * 0.85;

	COLOR = vec4(col * intensity * 1.6, 1.0);
}
"""

const POST_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform sampler2D screen_tex : hint_screen_texture, filter_linear_mipmap;
uniform float time = 0.0;
uniform float breath = 0.0;
uniform float tension = 0.0;
uniform float aspect = 1.7778;
uniform vec2 sun_uv = vec2(1.5, 0.5);
uniform float bloom_strength = 1.0;
uniform float vignette_strength = 0.75;
uniform float grain_strength = 1.0;
uniform float chroma_strength = 1.0;
uniform float heat_shimmer = 1.0;

float hash21(vec2 p) {
	vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
	p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);
	return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
}

void fragment() {
	vec2 uv = SCREEN_UV;
	vec2 c = uv - 0.5;
	vec2 sd = uv - sun_uv;
	sd.x *= aspect;

	float w = heat_shimmer / (1.0 + length(sd) * 0.45);
	vec2 haze = vec2(sin(uv.y * 85.0 + time * 3.1 + sin(uv.x * 37.0 + time * 1.3) * 2.0),
	                 cos(uv.x * 63.0 - time * 2.4 + sin(uv.y * 29.0 + time) * 2.0)) * 0.00085 * w;
	vec2 suv = uv + haze;

	float ca = chroma_strength * 0.0045 * (0.25 + dot(c, c) * 3.0);
	vec3 col;
	col.r = textureLod(screen_tex, suv + c * ca, 0.0).r;
	col.g = textureLod(screen_tex, suv, 0.0).g;
	col.b = textureLod(screen_tex, suv - c * ca, 0.0).b;

	vec3 hi = textureLod(screen_tex, suv, 3.0).rgb * 0.5 + textureLod(screen_tex, suv, 4.5).rgb * 0.5;
	vec3 avg = textureLod(screen_tex, suv, 7.0).rgb;
	vec3 bl = max(hi - avg * 0.80, vec3(0.0));
	col += bl * 0.70 * bloom_strength * (0.80 + 0.55 * breath + 0.35 * tension);
	col += avg * 0.10 * bloom_strength;

	vec3 st = vec3(0.0);
	for (int i = -4; i <= 4; i++) {
		vec3 s = textureLod(screen_tex, suv + vec2(float(i) * 0.028, 0.0), 4.0).rgb;
		st += s * (1.0 - abs(float(i)) / 5.0);
	}
	st /= 5.0;
	float st_l = dot(st, vec3(0.30, 0.59, 0.11));
	col += st * vec3(0.55, 0.78, 1.0) * smoothstep(0.80, 1.00, st_l) * 0.10 * bloom_strength;

	float lum = dot(col, vec3(0.30, 0.59, 0.11));
	col = mix(col, col * vec3(0.90, 0.97, 1.10), 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.30, lum));
	col = mix(col, col * col * (3.0 - 2.0 * col), 0.30);
	col *= 1.0 + 0.05 * (breath - 0.5);

	float vig = smoothstep(0.30, 1.05, length(c * vec2(aspect * 0.62, 1.0)) * 1.35);
	col *= 1.0 - vig * (vignette_strength + 0.20 * tension);

	float n = hash21(FRAGCOORD.xy + fract(time) * vec2(37.0, 91.0)) - 0.5;
	col += n * grain_strength * (0.030 + 0.035 * (1.0 - clamp(lum, 0.0, 1.0)));

	COLOR = vec4(col, 1.0);
}
"""

const SHIP_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform vec2 light_dir = vec2(1.0, 0.0);
uniform vec2 extent = vec2(140.0, 62.0);
uniform vec3 sun_light : source_color = vec3(1.0, 0.62, 0.26);
uniform float light_amount = 1.0;
uniform float breath = 0.0;
uniform float emissive_k = 1.0;
varying vec2 lp;

void vertex() {
	lp = VERTEX;
}

void fragment() {
	vec2 q = lp / extent;
	vec3 n = normalize(vec3(q.x * 0.85, q.y * 0.95, 0.55));
	vec3 L = normalize(vec3(light_dir, 0.30));
	float ndl = clamp(dot(n, L), 0.0, 1.0);
	float facing = max(dot(normalize(n.xy + vec2(0.0001)), light_dir), 0.0);
	float rim = pow(1.0 - n.z, 1.6) * facing;
	float emissive = emissive_k * smoothstep(0.30, 0.55, COLOR.b - COLOR.r);
	vec3 base = COLOR.rgb;
	vec3 ambient = vec3(0.62, 0.36, 0.22) * (0.8 + 0.5 * breath);
	vec3 lit = base * 1.25 * (ambient + sun_light * ndl * 1.5) * light_amount;
	lit += sun_light * rim * 1.4 * light_amount;
	lit += vec3(1.0, 0.8, 0.5) * pow(max(dot(n, normalize(L + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0))), 0.0), 40.0) * 0.5 * light_amount;
	COLOR.rgb = mix(lit, base * 1.1, emissive);
}
"""

class ShipRenderer extends Node2D:
	var time: float = 0.0
	var ship_texture: Texture2D

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		time += delta
		queue_redraw()

	func _draw() -> void:
		if ship_texture:
			var sz := ship_texture.get_size()
			draw_texture(ship_texture, -sz * 0.5)
			return

		var pod_l_top := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-100, -32), Vector2(-42, -32), Vector2(-52, -62), Vector2(-90, -62)])
		var pod_l_bot := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-100, 32), Vector2(-42, 32), Vector2(-52, 62), Vector2(-90, 62)])
		var pod_r_top := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(22, -32), Vector2(80, -32), Vector2(70, -62), Vector2(32, -62)])
		var pod_r_bot := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(22, 32), Vector2(80, 32), Vector2(70, 62), Vector2(32, 62)])
		
		draw_polygon(pod_l_top, [Color(0.28, 0.31, 0.36)])
		draw_polygon(pod_l_bot, [Color(0.16, 0.18, 0.22)])
		draw_polygon(pod_r_top, [Color(0.28, 0.31, 0.36)])
		draw_polygon(pod_r_bot, [Color(0.16, 0.18, 0.22)])

		var pod_edges := Color(0.10, 0.12, 0.15, 0.9)
		draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-100, -32), Vector2(-42, -32), Vector2(-52, -62), Vector2(-90, -62), Vector2(-100, -32)]), pod_edges, 1.0)
		draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-100, 32), Vector2(-42, 32), Vector2(-52, 62), Vector2(-90, 62), Vector2(-100, 32)]), pod_edges, 1.0)
		draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(22, -32), Vector2(80, -32), Vector2(70, -62), Vector2(32, -62), Vector2(22, -32)]), pod_edges, 1.0)
		draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(22, 32), Vector2(80, 32), Vector2(70, 62), Vector2(32, 62), Vector2(22, 32)]), pod_edges, 1.0)

		var hull := PackedVector2Array([
			Vector2(-140, -18), Vector2(-120, -42), Vector2(60, -42),
			Vector2(120, -25), Vector2(140, 0), Vector2(120, 25),
			Vector2(60, 42), Vector2(-120, 42), Vector2(-140, 18)
		])
		draw_polygon(hull, [Color(0.22, 0.25, 0.30)])

		var upper := PackedVector2Array([
			Vector2(-130, -16), Vector2(-110, -38), Vector2(50, -38),
			Vector2(110, -23), Vector2(130, 0), Vector2(110, 0),
			Vector2(50, -10), Vector2(-110, -10), Vector2(-130, 0)
		])
		draw_polygon(upper, [Color(0.34, 0.37, 0.42)])

		var lower := PackedVector2Array([
			Vector2(-130, 16), Vector2(-110, 38), Vector2(50, 38),
			Vector2(110, 23), Vector2(130, 0), Vector2(110, 0),
			Vector2(50, 10), Vector2(-110, 10), Vector2(-130, 0)
		])
		draw_polygon(lower, [Color(0.14, 0.16, 0.20)])

		var cockpit := PackedVector2Array([
			Vector2(60, -22), Vector2(105, -15), Vector2(125, 0),
			Vector2(105, 15), Vector2(60, 22), Vector2(40, 0)
		])
		draw_polygon(cockpit, [Color(0.04, 0.12, 0.25, 0.95)])

		var cockpit_inner := PackedVector2Array([
			Vector2(70, -16), Vector2(100, -10), Vector2(115, 0),
			Vector2(100, 10), Vector2(70, 16), Vector2(55, 0)
		])
		draw_polygon(cockpit_inner, [Color(0.14, 0.34, 0.55, 0.90)])
		draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(72, -14), Vector2(98, -8), Vector2(110, 0)]), Color(0.70, 0.90, 1.0, 0.70), 1.5)

		draw_rect(Rect2(-135, -30, 15, 60), Color(0.25, 0.28, 0.32))
		draw_rect(Rect2(-135, -30, 15, 60), Color(0.14, 0.16, 0.19), false, 1.0)

		var window_color := Color(0.30, 0.70, 1.0, 0.90)
		for i in range(4):
			var wx := -30.0 + i * 18.0
			draw_rect(Rect2(wx, -38, 8, 4), window_color)
			draw_rect(Rect2(wx, 34, 8, 4), window_color)

		var screw_color := Color(0.12, 0.13, 0.16)
		var screws := [
			Vector2(-100, -35), Vector2(-60, -35), Vector2(-20, -35),
			Vector2(20, -35), Vector2(50, -35),
			Vector2(-100, 35), Vector2(-60, 35), Vector2(-20, 35),
			Vector2(20, 35), Vector2(50, 35),
			Vector2(-125, -20), Vector2(-125, 20),
			Vector2(-70, -50), Vector2(-70, 50),
			Vector2(40, -50), Vector2(40, 50)
		]
		for sp in screws:
			draw_circle(sp, 1.2, screw_color)

		draw_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-130, -45), Vector2(-115, -45), Vector2(-120, -55)]), [Color(0.30, 0.60, 1.0, 0.60)])
		draw_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-130, 45), Vector2(-115, 45), Vector2(-120, 55)]), [Color(0.30, 0.60, 1.0, 0.60)])

		var outline := hull.duplicate()
		outline.append(hull[0])
		draw_polyline(outline, Color(0.55, 0.58, 0.62, 0.45), 1.0)

class EngineGlow extends Node2D:
	var time: float = 0.0
	var engine_x: float = -145.0
	var half_h: float = 18.0
	var power: float = 1.0

	func _ready() -> void:
		var m := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
		m.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
		material = m

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		time += delta
		queue_redraw()

	func _draw() -> void:
		var fl := (45.0 + sin(time * 20.0) * 8.0 + sin(time * 37.0) * 4.0 + sin(time * 61.0) * 2.5) * power
		var ex := engine_x
		for i in range(10):
			var k := float(i) / 9.0
			draw_circle(Vector2(ex - 6.0, 0.0), lerpf(95.0, 14.0, k), Color(0.25, 0.50, 1.0, 0.010 + 0.014 * k * power))
		var plume_a := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(ex, -half_h * 1.3), Vector2(ex - fl * 1.45, 0.0), Vector2(ex, half_h * 1.3)])
		var plume_b := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(ex, -half_h), Vector2(ex - fl, 0.0), Vector2(ex, half_h)])
		var plume_c := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(ex, -half_h * 0.55), Vector2(ex - fl * 0.62, 0.0), Vector2(ex, half_h * 0.55)])
		draw_polygon(plume_a, [Color(0.20, 0.45, 1.0, 0.20)])
		draw_polygon(plume_b, [Color(0.30, 0.60, 1.0, 0.55)])
		draw_polygon(plume_c, [Color(0.92, 0.96, 1.0, 0.95)])

class EmberField extends Node2D:
	var view_size: Vector2 = Vector2(1920, 1080)
	var drift: float = 25.0
	var intensity: float = 1.0
	var time: float = 0.0
	var pos := PackedVector2Array()
	var depth := PackedFloat32Array()
	var phase := PackedFloat32Array()

	func _ready() -> void:
		var m := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
		m.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
		material = m

	func setup(n: int, size: Vector2) -> void:
		view_size = size
		pos.resize(n)
		depth.resize(n)
		phase.resize(n)
		for i in range(n):
			pos[i] = Vector2(randf() * size.x, randf() * size.y)
			depth[i] = pow(randf(), 1.7)
			phase[i] = randf() * TAU

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		time += delta
		var s := view_size.y / 1080.0
		for i in range(pos.size()):
			var d := depth[i]
			var p := pos[i]
			p.x += (drift * (0.35 + 2.6 * d) + sin(time * 0.6 + phase[i]) * 14.0 * d) * delta
			p.y += (-(10.0 + 36.0 * d) * s + cos(time * 0.9 + phase[i] * 1.7) * 10.0) * delta
			if p.x > view_size.x + 40.0:
				p = Vector2(-40.0, randf() * view_size.y)
			elif p.x < -40.0:
				p.x = view_size.x + 40.0
			if p.y < -40.0:
				p = Vector2(randf() * view_size.x, view_size.y + 40.0)
			pos[i] = p
		queue_redraw()

	func _draw() -> void:
		var s := view_size.y / 1080.0
		for i in range(pos.size()):
			var d := depth[i]
			var tw := 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(time * (2.0 + d * 3.0) + phase[i])
			var hue := fposmod(phase[i] * 0.37, 1.0)
			var c := Color(1.0, 0.45 + 0.45 * hue, 0.12 + 0.50 * hue * hue)
			var sz := lerpf(1.1, 4.2, d * d) * s
			var a := (0.30 + 0.55 * d) * tw * intensity
			draw_circle(pos[i], sz * 4.5, Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, 0.045 * a))
			draw_circle(pos[i], sz, Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, a))
			if d > 0.9:
				draw_circle(pos[i], (20.0 + 30.0 * (d - 0.9) * 10.0) * s, Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.2, 0.028 * intensity))

	{"pos": Vector2.ZERO, "age": -1.0, "dur": 4.0, "str": 1.0},
	{"pos": Vector2.ZERO, "age": -1.0, "dur": 4.0, "str": 1.0},
	{"pos": Vector2.ZERO, "age": -1.0, "dur": 4.0, "str": 1.0},
]
var next_flare_time: float = 1.5
var sol_typed: String = ""
var sol_flash: float = 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
	get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_on_resize)
	rng.randomize()

	set_meta("no_polish", true)
	var _courier := SystemFont.new()
	_courier.font_names = PackedStringArray(["Courier New", "monospace"])
	font = _courier

	world = Control.new()
	world.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(world)
	world.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)

	_build_background()
	_build_sun()
	_build_mars()
	_build_ship()
	_build_embers()
	_build_sol_text()
	_build_post()
	_build_audio()
	_layout()

	var trans = get_node_or_null("/root/Transition")
	if trans:
		trans.overlay.modulate.a = 1.0
		trans.fade_from_black(fade_in_duration)

	_schedule_end()
	_delayed_type_sol()

func _make_mat(code: String) -> ShaderMaterial:
	var sh := Shader.new()
	sh.code = code
	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
	m.shader = sh
	return m

	bg_layer.material = bg_mat
	world.add_child(bg_layer)
	bg_layer.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)

		ship_mat.set_shader_parameter("emissive_k", 0.0)

func _build_audio() -> void:
	audio_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	audio_player.volume_db = audio_volume_db
	add_child(audio_player)
	if ambient_audio:
		var st = ambient_audio.duplicate()
		if "loop" in st:
			st.loop = true
		audio_player.stream = st
		audio_player.play()

	typing_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	typing_player.volume_db = typing_sfx_volume_db
	add_child(typing_player)
	if typing_sfx:
		typing_player.stream = typing_sfx

func _screen_to_sun_uv(sp: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	var half := container_size * 0.5
	return Vector2((sp.x - sun_center.x) / half / sun_radius_a, (sp.y - sun_center.y) / half / sun_radius_b)

func _sun_uv_to_lonlat(u: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	if u.length() > 0.9:
		u = u.normalized() * 0.9
	var z := sqrt(maxf(1.0 - u.length_squared(), 0.0001))
	return Vector2(atan2(u.x, z), asin(clampf(u.y, -0.999, 0.999)))

func _layout() -> void:
	view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
	world.pivot_offset = view_size * 0.5

	sun_center = Vector2(view_size.x * sun_center_x_ratio, view_size.y * sun_center_y_ratio)
	container_size = view_size.y * sun_container_size_ratio
	sun_container.size = Vector2(container_size, container_size)
	sun_container.position = sun_center - Vector2(container_size, container_size) * 0.5

	if mars_rect:
		mars_center = Vector2(view_size.x * mars_center_x_ratio, view_size.y * mars_center_y_ratio)
		var m_size: float = view_size.y * mars_size_ratio
		mars_rect.size = Vector2(m_size, m_size)
		mars_rect.position = mars_center - Vector2(m_size, m_size) * 0.5

	if ship_node:
		var ship_scale: float = view_size.y / 780.0 * ship_size_multiplier
		var x_sign := -1.0 if ship_facing_left else 1.0
		ship_node.scale = Vector2(ship_scale * x_sign, ship_scale)
		if not ship_placed:
			if ship_position_override != Vector2(-1, -1):
				ship_node.position = ship_position_override
			else:
				ship_node.position = Vector2(view_size.x * ship_start_x_ratio, view_size.y * ship_start_y_ratio)
			ship_home_y_ratio = ship_node.position.y / view_size.y
			ship_placed = true

	if embers:
		if embers.pos.size() != ember_count:
			embers.setup(ember_count, view_size)
		embers.view_size = view_size

	var sol_fs := clampi(int(min(view_size.x, view_size.y) * sol_font_size_ratio), 28, 80)
	sol_label.label_settings.font_size = sol_fs
	var pad: float = min(view_size.x, view_size.y) * sol_margin_ratio
	sol_base_pos = Vector2(pad, pad)
	sol_label.position = sol_base_pos

	if skip_label:
		skip_label.position = view_size - skip_label.size - Vector2(32, 28)

	var aspect := view_size.x / view_size.y
	bg_mat.set_shader_parameter("aspect", aspect)
	bg_mat.set_shader_parameter("lens_center", Vector2(sun_center.x / view_size.y, sun_center.y / view_size.y))
	bg_mat.set_shader_parameter("lens_radius", container_size * 0.5 / view_size.y)
	post_mat.set_shader_parameter("aspect", aspect)
	post_mat.set_shader_parameter("sun_uv", Vector2(sun_center.x / view_size.x, sun_center.y / view_size.y))

	var r_uv := sunspot_radius / (sun_container_size_ratio * 0.5)
	var la := _sun_uv_to_lonlat(_screen_to_sun_uv(Vector2(view_size.x * 0.74, view_size.y * 0.30)))
	var lb := _sun_uv_to_lonlat(_screen_to_sun_uv(Vector2(view_size.x * 0.30, view_size.y * 0.22)))
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("spot_a", Vector4(la.x, la.y, r_uv, 1.0))
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("spot_b", Vector4(lb.x, lb.y, r_uv * 0.55, 1.0))

func _on_resize() -> void:
	_layout()

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if scene_ending:
		return
	var pressed: bool = (event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo) \
		or (event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed) \
		or (event is InputEventJoypadButton and event.pressed)
	if not pressed:
		return

	if skip_armed_timer > 0.0:
		_end_cutscene()
	else:
		skip_armed_timer = 3.5

func _schedule_end() -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(total_duration).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree() or scene_ending:
		return
	_end_cutscene()

func _end_cutscene() -> void:
	if scene_ending:
		return
	scene_ending = true

	if audio_player and audio_player.playing:
		var at := create_tween()
		at.tween_property(audio_player, "volume_db", -60.0, fade_out_duration)

	var trans = get_node_or_null("/root/Transition")
	if trans:
		trans.change_scene(next_scene, fade_out_duration)
	else:
		get_tree().change_scene_to_file(next_scene)

func _delayed_type_sol() -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(sol_type_delay).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_type_sol()

var typing_active: bool = false

func _type_sol() -> void:
	if typing_started:
		return
	typing_started = true
	typing_active = true
	sol_typed = ""
	for i in range(sol_text.length()):
		if not is_inside_tree():
			return
		sol_typed = sol_text.substr(0, i + 1)
		sol_flash = 1.0
		if typing_player and typing_player.stream:
			typing_player.play()
		await get_tree().create_timer(sol_char_delay).timeout
	typing_active = false

func _apply_sun_uniforms() -> void:
	if not sun_inner_mat or not sun_outer_mat:
		return

	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("time", time)
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("sun_aspect", Vector2(sun_radius_a, sun_radius_b))
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("rotation_speed", sun_rotation_speed)
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("core_col", sun_core_color)
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("mid_col", sun_mid_color)
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("edge_col", sun_edge_color)
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("breath", breath)
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("breath_phase", breath_phase)
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("tension", tension)
	sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter("ring_strength", limb_ring_strength)
	var fnames := ["flare_a", "flare_b", "flare_c"]
	for i in range(3):
		var f: Dictionary = flares[i]
		var p: Vector2 = f["pos"]
		sun_inner_mat.set_shader_parameter(fnames[i], Vector4(p.x, p.y, f["age"], f["str"]))

	sun_outer_mat.set_shader_parameter("time", time)
	sun_outer_mat.set_shader_parameter("sun_aspect", Vector2(sun_radius_a, sun_radius_b))
	sun_outer_mat.set_shader_parameter("outer_uv", gas_radius)
	sun_outer_mat.set_shader_parameter("near_col", corona_near_color)
	sun_outer_mat.set_shader_parameter("mid_col", corona_mid_color)
	sun_outer_mat.set_shader_parameter("far_col", corona_far_color)

	if mars_mat:
		mars_mat.set_shader_parameter("time", time)
		mars_mat.set_shader_parameter("rotation_speed", mars_rotation_speed)
		mars_mat.set_shader_parameter("light_dir", (sun_center - mars_center).normalized())
		mars_mat.set_shader_parameter("breath", breath)

	bg_mat.set_shader_parameter("time", time)
	bg_mat.set_shader_parameter("nebula_a", nebula_a_color)
	bg_mat.set_shader_parameter("nebula_b", nebula_b_color)
	bg_mat.set_shader_parameter("star_col", star_color)
	bg_mat.set_shader_parameter("lens_strength", lens_strength)

func _update_breath(delta: float) -> void:
	breath_phase += delta / maxf(breath_period, 0.5) * (1.0 + 0.18 * sin(time * 0.41))
	var c := fposmod(breath_phase, 1.0)
	var b := 0.0
	if c < 0.38:
		b = smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, c / 0.38)
	else:
		b = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, (c - 0.38) / 0.62)
	b += sin(time * 5.3) * 0.025 * (0.3 + tension)
	breath = clampf(0.5 + (b - 0.5) * breath_depth, 0.0, 1.0)

func _update_flares(delta: float) -> void:
	for f in flares:
		if f["age"] >= 0.0:
			f["age"] += delta
			if f["age"] > f["dur"]:
				f["age"] = -1.0
	if time >= next_flare_time and not scene_ending:
		for f in flares:
			if f["age"] < 0.0:
				var sp := Vector2(rng.randf_range(0.08, 0.92) * view_size.x, rng.randf_range(0.10, 0.90) * view_size.y)
				var u := _screen_to_sun_uv(sp)
				if u.length() > 0.93:
					u = u.normalized() * 0.93
				f["pos"] = u
				f["age"] = 0.0
				f["str"] = rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.3)
				f["dur"] = rng.randf_range(3.2, 4.5)
				break
		next_flare_time = time + rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.8) * flare_interval / (1.0 + tension)

func _update_ship(delta: float) -> void:
	if not ship_node:
		return
	var s := view_size.y / 1080.0
	ship_node.position.x -= ship_drift_speed * delta * (view_size.y / 648.0)
	ship_node.position.y = view_size.y * ship_home_y_ratio + sin(time * 0.8) * 3.0 * s + sin(time * 13.0) * 0.6 * s * (0.5 + tension)
	ship_node.rotation = sin(time * 0.33) * 0.010 + sin(time * 11.0) * 0.0015 * (0.5 + tension)

	var to_sun := (sun_center - ship_node.position).normalized()
	var local_dir := ship_node.transform.affine_inverse().basis_xform(to_sun).normalized()
	ship_mat.set_shader_parameter("light_dir", local_dir)
	ship_mat.set_shader_parameter("light_amount", ship_sun_light * (0.85 + 0.30 * breath + 0.2 * tension))
	ship_mat.set_shader_parameter("breath", breath)
	if engine_glow:
		engine_glow.power = 1.0 + 0.20 * breath + 0.25 * tension
	if embers:
		embers.drift = ship_drift_speed * (view_size.y / 648.0)
		embers.intensity = 0.8 + 0.5 * breath + 0.4 * tension

func _update_camera() -> void:
	var s := 1.018 + camera_push * tension + 0.004 * breath
	var amp := minf(camera_shake * (view_size.y / 1080.0) * (1.2 + 3.5 * tension + 1.6 * breath), 14.0)
	var off := Vector2(
		sin(time * 1.7) + 0.6 * sin(time * 2.9 + 1.3) + 0.3 * sin(time * 7.3),
		sin(time * 2.1 + 0.7) + 0.5 * sin(time * 3.3) + 0.3 * sin(time * 6.1)) * amp
	world.scale = Vector2(s, s)
	world.position = off
	world.rotation = sin(time * 0.27) * 0.0025 * camera_shake

func _update_post() -> void:
	post_mat.set_shader_parameter("time", time)
	post_mat.set_shader_parameter("breath", breath)
	post_mat.set_shader_parameter("tension", tension)
	post_mat.set_shader_parameter("bloom_strength", bloom_strength)
	post_mat.set_shader_parameter("vignette_strength", vignette_strength)
	post_mat.set_shader_parameter("grain_strength", grain_strength)
	post_mat.set_shader_parameter("chroma_strength", chroma_strength)
	post_mat.set_shader_parameter("heat_shimmer", heat_shimmer)

func _update_text(delta: float) -> void:
	sol_flash = maxf(0.0, sol_flash - delta * 3.5)
	if typing_started:
		var show_cursor := typing_active or int(time * 2.4) % 2 == 0
		sol_label.text = sol_typed + ("_" if show_cursor else "")
	var flick := 0.93 + 0.07 * sin(time * 43.0) * sin(time * 7.0)
	var m := flick + sol_flash * 0.9
	sol_label.modulate = Color(m, m, m, minf(m, 1.0))
	var jitter := 0.0
	if rng.randf() < 0.012:
		jitter = rng.randf_range(-2.5, 2.5)
	sol_label.position = sol_base_pos + Vector2(jitter, 0.0)

	if skip_label:
		skip_label.position = view_size - skip_label.size - Vector2(32, 28)
		if skip_armed_timer > 0.0:
			skip_armed_timer = maxf(0.0, skip_armed_timer - delta)
			var target_a: float = 0.65 + 0.25 * sin(time * 8.0) if skip_armed_timer > 0.5 else (skip_armed_timer / 0.5) * 0.8
			skip_label.modulate.a = lerpf(skip_label.modulate.a, target_a, delta * 14.0)
		else:
			skip_label.modulate.a = lerpf(skip_label.modulate.a, 0.0, delta * 10.0)

func _update_audio() -> void:
	if audio_player and audio_player.playing and not scene_ending:
		audio_player.volume_db = audio_volume_db + (breath - 0.5) * 3.0 + tension * 2.0

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	time += delta
	var t01 := clampf(time / maxf(total_duration, 0.1), 0.0, 1.0)
	tension = t01 * t01 * (3.0 - 2.0 * t01)

	_update_breath(delta)
	_update_flares(delta)
	_apply_sun_uniforms()
	_update_ship(delta)
	_update_camera()
	_update_post()
	_update_text(delta)
	_update_audio()

extends Node2D
