var _fallback_settings: Node = null

func _gs() -> Node:
	var g := get_node_or_null("/root/GameSettings")
	if g != null:
		return g
	if _fallback_settings == null:
		var script_res := load("res://scripts/autoloads/GameSettings.gd")
		if script_res != null:
			_fallback_settings = script_res.new()
			_fallback_settings.name = "GameSettings"
			get_tree().root.add_child.call_deferred(_fallback_settings)
	return _fallback_settings

func _get_setting(key: String, default_val: Variant) -> Variant:
	var gs := _gs()
	if gs != null and "settings" in gs:
		return gs.settings.get(key, default_val)
	return default_val

func _set_setting(key: String, val: Variant) -> void:
	var gs := _gs()
	if gs != null and "settings" in gs:
		gs.settings[key] = val
		gs.dirty = true
		if gs.has_method("apply_settings"):
			gs.apply_settings()

func _is_dirty() -> bool:
	var gs := _gs()
	if gs != null and "dirty" in gs:
		return gs.dirty
	return false

func _set_dirty(val: bool) -> void:
	var gs := _gs()
	if gs != null and "dirty" in gs:
		gs.dirty = val

func _ready() -> void:
	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_ALL
	clip_contents = false

	_gs()

	set_meta("no_polish", true)
	var _courier := SystemFont.new()
	_courier.font_names = PackedStringArray(["Courier New", "monospace"])
	font = _courier

	_create_background_layer()
	_create_glow_layer()

	_build_gameplay_page()
	reveal = 0.0
	animate_reveal = true
	get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_on_resized)
	_on_resized()

func _create_background_layer() -> void:
	bg_layer = ColorRect.new()
	bg_layer.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	bg_layer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	bg_layer.color = bg_color
	bg_layer.z_index = -3
	add_child(bg_layer)

func _create_glow_layer() -> void:
	glow_layer = ColorRect.new()
	glow_layer.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	glow_layer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	glow_layer.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
	glow_layer.z_index = -1

	var shader := Shader.new()
	shader.code = SPACE_MENU_SHADER
	var mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
	mat.shader = shader
	glow_layer.material = mat
	add_child(glow_layer)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	time += delta
	if animate_reveal and reveal < 1.0:
		reveal = minf(reveal + delta * reveal_speed, 1.0)
		queue_redraw()
	elif animate_reveal and reveal >= 1.0:
		animate_reveal = false

	queue_redraw()

	if glow_layer:
		var mat := glow_layer.material as ShaderMaterial
		mat.set_shader_parameter("time", time)

func _on_resized() -> void:
	var vs := get_viewport_rect().size
	var base := minf(vs.x, vs.y)
	font_size = clampi(int(base * 0.045), 24, 44)
	line_height = int(font_size * 1.32)
	padding = font_size

	var top_area := padding + line_height * 2
	var bottom_area := line_height * 2
	var available_height := size.y - top_area - bottom_area
	max_visible_rows = maxi(1, int(available_height / line_height))

	_update_scroll_range()
	queue_redraw()

func _update_scroll_range() -> void:
	var max_scroll := maxi(0, entries.size() - max_visible_rows)
	scroll_offset = clampi(scroll_offset, 0, max_scroll)

func _compute_float(phase: float) -> Vector3:
	var y_offset := sin(time * float_speed_y * TAU + phase) * float_amp_y + sin(time * float_speed_y * 1.7 + phase * 2.0) * float_amp_y * 0.4
	var x_offset := sin(time * float_speed_x * TAU + phase * 0.7) * float_amp_x + cos(time * float_speed_x * 1.3 + phase) * float_amp_x * 0.5
	var rot_offset := sin(time * float_rot_speed * TAU + phase) * float_rot_amp
	return Vector3(x_offset, y_offset, rot_offset)

func _get_entry_float_index(index: int) -> int:
	return section_names.size() + (index - scroll_offset)

func _draw() -> void:
	text_float_index = 0
	glow_positions.clear()

	var y := padding
	var total_width := size.x - 2.0 * padding
	var num_sections := section_names.size()
	for i in range(num_sections):
		var section_text := section_names[i]
		if i == selected_section:
			section_text = "Ã¢Å“Â¦ [ " + section_text + " ] Ã¢Å“Â¦"
		else:
			section_text = "  " + section_text + "  "
		var col := highlight_color if i == selected_section else text_color
		var text_width := font.get_string_size(section_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size).x
		var center_x := padding + total_width * (i + 0.5) / num_sections
		var pos := Vector2(center_x - text_width / 2.0, y + font.get_ascent(font_size))
		_draw_text(pos, section_text, col)

	var options_start_y := padding + line_height * 2
	var end_idx := mini(scroll_offset + max_visible_rows, entries.size())
	for i in range(scroll_offset, end_idx):
		var line_y := options_start_y + (i - scroll_offset) * line_height
		var layout := _get_entry_layout(i, line_y)
		var line_text: String = layout["text"]
		var is_rebind_target = binding_mode and i == selected_index and entries[i].action == "rebind"
		var col := highlight_color if layout["active"] else text_color
		if is_rebind_target:
			col = accent_cyan
		var display_text := line_text
		if animate_reveal:
			var visible_chars := int(reveal * line_text.length())
			display_text = line_text.substr(0, visible_chars)
		_draw_text(Vector2(padding, line_y + font.get_ascent(font_size)), display_text, col)

	_draw_bottom_actions()

	if binding_mode:
		_draw_binding_prompt()

	if dropdown_open:
		_draw_dropdown()

	if confirming_exit:
		_draw_confirm_dialog()

	_update_glow_shader()

func _draw_binding_prompt() -> void:
	var friendly_name := rebinding_action.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
	var line1 := "Press any button to bind it to %s" % friendly_name
	var line2 := "Press ESC to cancel, press DELETE to remove last input"

	var box_width := minf(size.x * 0.45, 520.0)
	var box_padding := dropdown_padding * 2.0
	var max_line_width := box_width - 2.0 * box_padding
	var wrapped_lines: Array[String] = []
	wrapped_lines.append_array(_wrap_text(line1, max_line_width))
	wrapped_lines.append_array(_wrap_text(line2, max_line_width))

	var total_lines := wrapped_lines.size()
	var box_height := total_lines * line_height + box_padding * 2.0

	var box_x := size.x - box_width - padding
	var box_y := size.y - line_height * 2 - box_height - padding
	var prompt_phase := _get_entry_float_index(selected_index) * float_phase_offset
	var f := _compute_float(prompt_phase)

	draw_set_transform(Vector2(f.x, f.y), f.z, Vector2.ONE)

	var rect := Rect2(box_x, box_y, box_width, box_height)
	draw_rect(rect, Color(0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.96))
	draw_rect(rect, highlight_color, false, 2.0)

	for idx in range(total_lines):
		var line_y_pos := box_y + box_padding + idx * line_height + font.get_ascent(font_size)
		var text_pos := Vector2(box_x + box_padding, line_y_pos)
		draw_string(font, text_pos, wrapped_lines[idx], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size, highlight_color)

	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)

func _wrap_text(text: String, max_width: float) -> Array[String]:
	var words := text.split(" ", false)
	var lines: Array[String] = []
	var current_line := ""
	for w in words:
		var test_line := current_line + (" " if current_line != "" else "") + w
		var w_width := font.get_string_size(test_line, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size).x
		if w_width > max_width and current_line != "":
			lines.append(current_line)
			current_line = w
		else:
			current_line = test_line
	if current_line != "":
		lines.append(current_line)
	if lines.is_empty():
		lines.append(text)
	return lines

func _draw_bottom_actions() -> void:
	var bottom_y := size.y - line_height * 2
	var gap := font_size * 4.5
	var x := padding

	for i in range(bottom_actions.size()):
		var action_text := bottom_actions[i]
		var is_selected := focus_on_bottom and i == selected_bottom_index

		var display_text := ("Ã¢Å“Â¦ > " if is_selected else "    ") + action_text
		var drawn_text := display_text
		if animate_reveal:
			var visible_chars := int(reveal * display_text.length())
			drawn_text = display_text.substr(0, visible_chars)

		var col: Color
		if action_text == "SAVE":
			if is_selected or _is_dirty():
				col = highlight_color
			else:
				col = dim_color
		else:
			col = highlight_color if is_selected else text_color

		_draw_text(Vector2(x, bottom_y + font.get_ascent(font_size)), drawn_text, col)
		x += font.get_string_size(display_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size).x + gap

func _draw_text_with_phase(pos: Vector2, text: String, color: Color, phase: float) -> void:
	var f := _compute_float(phase)
	var text_size := font.get_string_size(text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size)
	var text_center := pos + Vector2(f.x, f.y) + Vector2(text_size.x / 2.0, -text_size.y / 2.0)

	draw_set_transform(text_center, f.z, Vector2.ONE)
	draw_string(font, -Vector2(text_size.x / 2.0, -text_size.y / 2.0), text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size, color)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)

	glow_positions.append(text_center)

func _draw_text(pos: Vector2, text: String, color: Color) -> void:
	var phase := text_float_index * float_phase_offset
	_draw_text_with_phase(pos, text, color, phase)
	text_float_index += 1

func _get_dropdown_rect() -> Rect2:
	var dd_x := dropdown_anchor.x
	var dd_y := dropdown_anchor.y
	var max_width := 0.0
	for i in range(dropdown_options.size()):
		var display_val := str(dropdown_options[i])
		if dropdown_target == "max_fps" and int(dropdown_options[i]) == 0:
			display_val = "Uncapped"
		var prefix := "> " if i == dropdown_selected else "  "
		var w := font.get_string_size(prefix + display_val, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size).x
		if w > max_width:
			max_width = w

	var dd_width := minf(max_width + 2.0 * dropdown_padding, size.x - dd_x - padding)
	var dd_height := dropdown_options.size() * line_height + 2.0 * dropdown_padding
	return Rect2(dd_x, dd_y, dd_width, dd_height)

func _draw_dropdown() -> void:
	var parent_phase := _get_entry_float_index(dropdown_parent_index) * float_phase_offset
	var f := _compute_float(parent_phase)
	var dd_rect := _get_dropdown_rect()

	draw_set_transform(Vector2(f.x, f.y), f.z, Vector2.ONE)
	draw_rect(Rect2(dd_rect.position, dd_rect.size), Color(0.01, 0.015, 0.04, 0.98))
	draw_rect(Rect2(dd_rect.position, dd_rect.size), highlight_color, false, 2.0)

	for i in range(dropdown_options.size()):
		var prefix := "> " if i == dropdown_selected else "  "
		var display_val := str(dropdown_options[i])
		if dropdown_target == "max_fps" and int(dropdown_options[i]) == 0:
			display_val = "Uncapped"
		var col := highlight_color if i == dropdown_selected else text_color
		var text_pos := Vector2(
			dd_rect.position.x + dropdown_padding,
			dd_rect.position.y + dropdown_padding + i * line_height + font.get_ascent(font_size)
		)
		draw_string(font, text_pos, prefix + display_val, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size, col)

	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)

func _update_glow_shader() -> void:
	if glow_layer == null:
		return
	var mat := glow_layer.material as ShaderMaterial
	var vs := get_viewport_rect().size
	var count := mini(glow_positions.size(), 32)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("glow_count", count)
	var pos_array := []
	for i in range(count):
		pos_array.append(Vector2(glow_positions[i].x / maxf(vs.x, 1.0), glow_positions[i].y / maxf(vs.y, 1.0)))
	for i in range(count, 32):
		pos_array.append(Vector2.ZERO)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("glow_positions", pos_array)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("base_glow_color", base_glow_color)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("ring_color", ring_color)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("secondary_ring_color", secondary_ring_color)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("foam_color", foam_color)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("nebula_a", nebula_a)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("nebula_b", nebula_b)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("bleed", bleed)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("ring_speed", ring_speed)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("secondary_ring_speed", secondary_ring_speed)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("foam_speed", foam_speed)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("foam_width", foam_width)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("foam_wave_freq", foam_wave_freq)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("foam_wave_amp", foam_wave_amp)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("circle_correction", circle_correction)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("glow_strength", glow_strength)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("inv_aspect", vs.y / maxf(vs.x, 1.0))

func _draw_confirm_dialog() -> void:
	draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.90))
	var prompt := "Unsaved telemetry changes! Confirm action:"
	var options := ["Save & Exit", "Exit Without Saving", "Cancel"]
	var px := padding
	var py := size.y * 0.3
	_draw_text(Vector2(px, py + font.get_ascent(font_size)), prompt, accent_cyan)
	confirm_rects.clear()
	var y := py + line_height * 1.5
	for i in range(options.size()):
		var col := highlight_color if i == confirm_selected else text_color
		_draw_text(Vector2(px, y + font.get_ascent(font_size)), ("> " if i == confirm_selected else "  ") + options[i], col)
		confirm_rects.append(Rect2(px, y, size.x - px * 2.0, line_height))
		y += line_height

func _build_gameplay_page() -> void:
	current_page = "gameplay"
	entries.clear()
	entries.append({"text": _bool_text("Particles", _get_setting("particles", true)), "action": "toggle", "param": "particles"})
	entries.append({"text": _bool_text("Glow", _get_setting("glow", true)), "action": "toggle", "param": "glow"})
	entries.append({"text": _bool_text("Screen Shake", _get_setting("screen_shake", true)), "action": "toggle", "param": "screen_shake"})
	entries.append({"text": _bool_text("Low Detail Mode", _get_setting("low_detail", false)), "action": "toggle", "param": "low_detail"})
	scroll_offset = 0
	_update_scroll_range()
	queue_redraw()

func _build_audio_page() -> void:
	current_page = "audio"
	entries.clear()
	entries.append(_slider_entry("Master Volume", "master_volume", 0, 100))
	entries.append(_slider_entry("SFX Volume", "sfx_volume", 0, 100))
	entries.append(_slider_entry("Music Volume", "music_volume", 0, 100))
	scroll_offset = 0
	_update_scroll_range()
	queue_redraw()

func _build_graphics_page() -> void:
	current_page = "graphics"
	entries.clear()
	entries.append(_cycle_entry("Resolution", "resolution", ["1280x720", "1600x900", "1920x1080", "2560x1440"]))
	entries.append({"text": _bool_text("VSync", _get_setting("vsync", true)), "action": "toggle", "param": "vsync"})
	entries.append(_cycle_entry("Max FPS", "max_fps", [0, 30, 60, 120, 144, 240]))
	entries.append(_cycle_entry("MSAA", "msaa", ["Off", "2x", "4x", "8x"]))
	entries.append(_cycle_entry("Window Mode", "window_mode", ["Windowed", "Fullscreen", "Borderless"]))
	entries.append(_slider_entry("Brightness", "brightness", 20, 200))
	scroll_offset = 0
	_update_scroll_range()
	queue_redraw()

func _build_controls_page() -> void:
	current_page = "controls"
	entries.clear()
	var actions := _get_custom_actions()
	if actions.is_empty():
		entries.append({"text": "No custom actions found", "action": "back"})
	else:
		for action in actions:
			var bindings_display := _get_action_bindings_display(action)
			var friendly_name := action.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
			entries.append({
				"text": "%s: %s" % [friendly_name, bindings_display],
				"action": "rebind",
				"param": action
			})
	entries.append({"text": "Reset Keybinds", "action": "reset_keys"})
	_update_scroll_range()
	queue_redraw()

func _get_action_bindings_display(action: String) -> String:
	var events := InputMap.action_get_events(action)
	if events.is_empty():
		return "[None]"
	var parts := []
	for e in events:
		var label := _get_event_display(e)
		if label != "":
			parts.append("[%s]" % label)
	if parts.is_empty():
		return "[None]"
	return " ".join(parts)

func _get_event_display(event: InputEvent) -> String:
	if event is InputEventKey:
		var kc = event.keycode
		if kc == KEY_NONE and event.physical_keycode != KEY_NONE:
			kc = DisplayServer.keyboard_get_keycode_from_physical(event.physical_keycode)
		return OS.get_keycode_string(kc)
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton:
		match event.button_index:
			MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT: return "Left Mouse"
			MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT: return "Right Mouse"
			MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE: return "Middle Mouse"
			_: return "Mouse " + str(event.button_index)
	elif event is InputEventJoypadButton:
		return "%s (Joypad)" % _get_joypad_button_name(event.button_index)
	elif event is InputEventJoypadMotion:
		var axis_name := _get_joypad_axis_name(event.axis)
		var sgn := " +" if event.axis_value > 0 else " -"
		return "%s%s" % [axis_name, sgn]
	return ""

func _get_joypad_button_name(button: int) -> String:
	match button:
		0: return "A"
		1: return "B"
		2: return "X"
		3: return "Y"
		4: return "L1"
		5: return "R1"
		6: return "L2"
		7: return "R2"
		8: return "Back"
		9: return "Start"
		10: return "L3"
		11: return "R3"
		12: return "D-Pad Up"
		13: return "D-Pad Down"
		14: return "D-Pad Left"
		15: return "D-Pad Right"
		16: return "Guide"
		_: return "Button %d" % button

func _get_joypad_axis_name(axis: int) -> String:
	match axis:
		JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X: return "Left Stick X"
		JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y: return "Left Stick Y"
		JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_X: return "Right Stick X"
		JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_Y: return "Right Stick Y"
		JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_LEFT: return "Left Trigger"
		JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_RIGHT: return "Right Trigger"
		_: return "Axis %d" % axis

func _rebuild_current_page() -> void:
	var old_index := selected_index
	var old_scroll := scroll_offset
	match current_page:
		"gameplay": _build_gameplay_page()
		"audio": _build_audio_page()
		"graphics": _build_graphics_page()
		"controls": _build_controls_page()
		_: _build_gameplay_page()
	selected_index = clampi(old_index, 0, maxi(0, entries.size() - 1))
	var max_scroll := maxi(0, entries.size() - max_visible_rows)
	scroll_offset = clampi(old_scroll, 0, max_scroll)
	_update_scroll_range()
	queue_redraw()

func _open_section(idx: int) -> void:
	selected_section = idx
	selected_index = 0
	scroll_offset = 0
	focus_on_sections = false
	focus_on_bottom = false
	reveal = 0.0
	animate_reveal = true
	match idx:
		0: _build_gameplay_page()
		1: _build_audio_page()
		2: _build_graphics_page()
		3: _build_controls_page()
	queue_redraw()

func _get_entry_layout(i: int, line_y: float) -> Dictionary:
	var is_active := (i == selected_index and not focus_on_sections and not focus_on_bottom)
	var prefix := "Ã¢Å“Â¦ > " if is_active else "    "
	var full_text: String = prefix + entries[i].text
	var layout := {
		"y": line_y,
		"x": padding,
		"text": full_text,
		"active": is_active,
		"param": entries[i].get("param", ""),
		"min": entries[i].get("min", 0),
		"max": entries[i].get("max", 100)
	}
	if entries[i].action == "adjust":
		var bracket_open := full_text.find("[")
		var bracket_close := full_text.find("]", bracket_open + 1)
		if bracket_open != -1 and bracket_close != -1:
			var label_before_open := full_text.substr(0, bracket_open)
			var label_before_close := full_text.substr(0, bracket_close + 1)
			var start_x := padding + font.get_string_size(label_before_open, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size).x
			var end_x := padding + font.get_string_size(label_before_close, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size).x
			var bracket_width := font.get_string_size("[", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size).x
			var bar_start_x := start_x + bracket_width
			var bar_end_x := end_x - bracket_width
			layout["bar_start_x"] = bar_start_x
			layout["bar_end_x"] = bar_end_x
			layout["bar_rect"] = Rect2(bar_start_x, line_y, bar_end_x - bar_start_x, line_height)
	return layout

func _line_index_from_pos(pos: Vector2) -> int:
	if pos.y >= size.y - line_height * 2:
		return -1
	var options_start_y := padding + line_height * 2
	var rel_y := pos.y - options_start_y
	if rel_y < 0 or rel_y >= max_visible_rows * line_height:
		return -1
	var visible_index := int(rel_y / line_height)
	var actual_index := scroll_offset + visible_index
	if actual_index < 0 or actual_index >= entries.size():
		return -1
	if pos.x < padding or pos.x > size.x - padding:
		return -1
	return actual_index

func _section_index_from_pos(pos: Vector2) -> int:
	if pos.y < 0 or pos.y > line_height * 2:
		return -1
	var total_width := size.x - 2.0 * padding
	var num_sections := section_names.size()
	for i in range(num_sections):
		var section_text := section_names[i]
		if i == selected_section:
			section_text = "Ã¢Å“Â¦ [ " + section_text + " ] Ã¢Å“Â¦"
		else:
			section_text = "  " + section_text + "  "
		var text_width := font.get_string_size(section_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size).x
		var center_x := padding + total_width * (i + 0.5) / num_sections
		if pos.x >= center_x - text_width / 2.0 and pos.x <= center_x + text_width / 2.0:
			return i
	return -1

func _bottom_action_index(pos: Vector2) -> int:
	if pos.y < size.y - line_height * 2 or pos.y >= size.y - line_height:
		return -1
	var x := padding
	var gap := font_size * 4.5
	for i in range(bottom_actions.size()):
		var display_text := ("Ã¢Å“Â¦ > " if focus_on_bottom and i == selected_bottom_index else "    ") + bottom_actions[i]
		var width := font.get_string_size(display_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size).x
		var segment_width := width + gap
		if pos.x >= x and pos.x < x + segment_width:
			return i
		x += segment_width
	return -1

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if confirming_exit:
		_input_confirm(event)
		return
	if dropdown_open:
		_input_dropdown(event)
		return
	if binding_mode:
		_input_binding(event)
		return
	if awaiting_input:
		_input_rebind(event)
		return

	if event is InputEventMouseMotion:
		using_mouse = true
		if dragging_slider:
			_handle_mouse_motion(event.position)
		else:
			var idx := _line_index_from_pos(event.position)
			if idx != -1:
				selected_index = idx
				focus_on_sections = false
				focus_on_bottom = false
				queue_redraw()
			else:
				var bottom_idx := _bottom_action_index(event.position)
				if bottom_idx != -1:
					selected_bottom_index = bottom_idx
					focus_on_bottom = true
					focus_on_sections = false
					queue_redraw()
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton:
		if event.pressed:
			using_mouse = true
			if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
				var bottom_idx := _bottom_action_index(event.position)
				if bottom_idx != -1:
					_handle_bottom_action(bottom_idx)
					return

				if event.position.y < line_height * 2:
					var sec_idx := _section_index_from_pos(event.position)
					if sec_idx != -1:
						selected_section = sec_idx
						_open_section(selected_section)
						queue_redraw()
					return

				var idx := _line_index_from_pos(event.position)
				if idx >= 0 and idx < entries.size():
					selected_index = idx
					focus_on_sections = false
					focus_on_bottom = false
					var entry := entries[idx]
					if entry.action == "adjust":
						var line_y := padding + line_height * 2 + (idx - scroll_offset) * line_height
						var base_rect := _get_base_bar_rect(idx, line_y)
						if base_rect.size.x > 0:
							var float_offset := _get_float_offset_for_entry(idx)
							var actual_rect := Rect2(base_rect.position + float_offset, base_rect.size).grow(5)
							if actual_rect.has_point(event.position):
								dragging_slider = true
								_handle_mouse_motion(event.position)
							else:
								_activate_selected()
						else:
							_activate_selected()
					else:
						_activate_selected()
			elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
				if scroll_offset > 0:
					scroll_offset -= 1
					_update_scroll_range()
					queue_redraw()
			elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
				var max_scroll := maxi(0, entries.size() - max_visible_rows)
				if scroll_offset < max_scroll:
					scroll_offset += 1
					_update_scroll_range()
					queue_redraw()
		else:
			if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and dragging_slider:
				dragging_slider = false
	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed:
		using_mouse = false
		match event.keycode:
			KEY_UP, KEY_W: _navigate_up()
			KEY_DOWN, KEY_S: _navigate_down()
			KEY_LEFT, KEY_A: _navigate_left()
			KEY_RIGHT, KEY_D: _navigate_right()
			KEY_ENTER, KEY_KP_ENTER, KEY_SPACE:
				if not event.echo:
					_activate_focused()
			KEY_ESCAPE:
				if not event.echo:
					_back()

func _navigate_up() -> void:
	if focus_on_sections:
		selected_section = (selected_section - 1 + section_names.size()) % section_names.size()
	elif focus_on_bottom:
		focus_on_bottom = false
		focus_on_sections = false
		selected_index = mini(entries.size() - 1, scroll_offset + max_visible_rows - 1)
	else:
		if selected_index > 0:
			selected_index -= 1
			if selected_index < scroll_offset:
				scroll_offset = selected_index
				_update_scroll_range()
		else:
			focus_on_sections = true
	queue_redraw()

func _navigate_down() -> void:
	if focus_on_sections:
		focus_on_sections = false
		selected_index = 0
	elif focus_on_bottom:
		selected_bottom_index = (selected_bottom_index + 1) % bottom_actions.size()
	else:
		if selected_index < entries.size() - 1:
			selected_index += 1
			if selected_index >= scroll_offset + max_visible_rows:
				scroll_offset = selected_index - max_visible_rows + 1
				_update_scroll_range()
		else:
			focus_on_bottom = true
			focus_on_sections = false
			selected_bottom_index = 0
	queue_redraw()

func _navigate_left() -> void:
	if focus_on_sections:
		selected_section = (selected_section - 1 + section_names.size()) % section_names.size()
		_open_section(selected_section)
	elif focus_on_bottom:
		selected_bottom_index = (selected_bottom_index - 1 + bottom_actions.size()) % bottom_actions.size()
	else:
		_adjust_option(-1)
	queue_redraw()

func _navigate_right() -> void:
	if focus_on_sections:
		selected_section = (selected_section + 1) % section_names.size()
		_open_section(selected_section)
	elif focus_on_bottom:
		selected_bottom_index = (selected_bottom_index + 1) % bottom_actions.size()
	else:
		_adjust_option(1)
	queue_redraw()

func _activate_focused() -> void:
	if focus_on_sections:
		_open_section(selected_section)
	elif focus_on_bottom:
		_handle_bottom_action(selected_bottom_index)
	else:
		_activate_selected()

func _handle_bottom_action(index: int) -> void:
	match bottom_actions[index]:
		"SAVE": _save_all()
		"BACK": _exit_action()
		"RESET ALL": _reset_all_action()

func _reset_all_action() -> void:
	var gs := _gs()
	if gs != null:
		if gs.has_method("reset_settings_to_default"): gs.reset_settings_to_default()
		if gs.has_method("save_settings"): gs.save_settings()
	_set_dirty(false)
	_rebuild_current_page()

func _reset_keys_action() -> void:
	var gs := _gs()
	if gs != null:
		if gs.has_method("reset_inputs_to_default"): gs.reset_inputs_to_default()
		if gs.has_method("save_player_input_map"): gs.save_player_input_map()
	else:
		InputMap.load_from_project_settings()
	_rebuild_current_page()

func _exit_action() -> void:
	if _is_dirty():
		confirming_exit = true
		confirm_selected = 0
		focus_on_sections = false
		focus_on_bottom = false
		queue_redraw()
	else:
		_exit_to_main_menu()

func _back() -> void:
	if binding_mode:
		binding_mode = false
		rebinding_action = ""
		_rebuild_current_page()
		return
	if awaiting_input:
		awaiting_input = false
		_rebuild_current_page()
		return
	if dropdown_open:
		dropdown_open = false
		_rebuild_current_page()
		return
	if focus_on_sections:
		_exit_action()
		return
	if focus_on_bottom:
		focus_on_bottom = false
		selected_index = mini(entries.size() - 1, scroll_offset + max_visible_rows - 1)
		queue_redraw()
		return
	focus_on_sections = true
	focus_on_bottom = false
	queue_redraw()

func _handle_mouse_motion(pos: Vector2) -> void:
	if not dragging_slider:
		return
	var line_y := padding + line_height * 2 + (selected_index - scroll_offset) * line_height
	var base_rect := _get_base_bar_rect(selected_index, line_y)
	if base_rect.size.x <= 0:
		return
	var float_offset := _get_float_offset_for_entry(selected_index)
	var actual_rect := Rect2(base_rect.position + float_offset, base_rect.size).grow(5)
	var ratio := clampf((pos.x - actual_rect.position.x) / actual_rect.size.x, 0.0, 1.0)
	var entry := entries[selected_index]
	_set_setting(entry.param, int(entry.min + ratio * (entry.max - entry.min)))
	_rebuild_current_page()

func _get_float_offset_for_entry(index: int) -> Vector2:
	var phase := _get_entry_float_index(index) * float_phase_offset
	var f := _compute_float(phase)
	return Vector2(f.x, f.y)

func _get_base_bar_rect(index: int, line_y: float) -> Rect2:
	var layout := _get_entry_layout(index, line_y)
	if layout.has("bar_rect"):
		return layout["bar_rect"]
	return Rect2()

func _input_confirm(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		match event.keycode:
			KEY_UP, KEY_W:
				confirm_selected = (confirm_selected - 1 + 3) % 3
				queue_redraw()
			KEY_DOWN, KEY_S:
				confirm_selected = (confirm_selected + 1) % 3
				queue_redraw()
			KEY_ENTER, KEY_KP_ENTER, KEY_SPACE:
				_confirm_execute(confirm_selected)
			KEY_ESCAPE:
				confirming_exit = false
				_rebuild_current_page()
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		for i in range(confirm_rects.size()):
			if confirm_rects[i].has_point(event.position):
				_confirm_execute(i)
				break
	elif event is InputEventMouseMotion:
		for i in range(confirm_rects.size()):
			if confirm_rects[i].has_point(event.position) and confirm_selected != i:
				confirm_selected = i
				queue_redraw()
				break

func _confirm_execute(index: int) -> void:
	match index:
		0:
			_save_all()
			_exit_to_main_menu()
		1:
			var gs := _gs()
			if gs != null:
				if gs.has_method("load_settings"): gs.load_settings()
				if gs.has_method("load_player_input_map"): gs.load_player_input_map()
				if gs.has_method("apply_settings"): gs.apply_settings()
			_set_dirty(false)
			_exit_to_main_menu()
		2:
			confirming_exit = false
			_rebuild_current_page()

func _input_binding(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		if event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
			binding_mode = false
			rebinding_action = ""
			_rebuild_current_page()
		elif event.keycode == KEY_DELETE or event.keycode == KEY_BACKSPACE:
			_remove_last_binding(rebinding_action)
			binding_mode = false
			rebinding_action = ""
			_rebuild_current_page()
		else:
			_add_binding(rebinding_action, event)
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		if event.button_index in [MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT, MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT, MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE]:
			_add_binding(rebinding_action, event)
	elif event is InputEventJoypadButton and event.pressed:
		_add_binding(rebinding_action, event)
	elif event is InputEventJoypadMotion and absf(event.axis_value) >= 0.5:
		var ev := InputEventJoypadMotion.new()
		ev.axis = event.axis
		ev.axis_value = 1.0 if event.axis_value > 0 else -1.0
		_add_binding(rebinding_action, ev)

func _add_binding(action: String, event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not InputMap.has_action(action):
		return
	for e in InputMap.action_get_events(action):
		if _events_equal(e, event):
			return
	InputMap.action_add_event(action, event)
	_set_dirty(true)
	binding_mode = false
	rebinding_action = ""
	_rebuild_current_page()

func _remove_last_binding(action: String) -> void:
	if not InputMap.has_action(action):
		return
	var events := InputMap.action_get_events(action)
	if not events.is_empty():
		InputMap.action_erase_event(action, events[-1])
		_set_dirty(true)

func _events_equal(a: InputEvent, b: InputEvent) -> bool:
	if a is InputEventKey and b is InputEventKey:
		return a.keycode == b.keycode and a.physical_keycode == b.physical_keycode
	elif a is InputEventMouseButton and b is InputEventMouseButton:
		return a.button_index == b.button_index
	elif a is InputEventJoypadButton and b is InputEventJoypadButton:
		return a.button_index == b.button_index
	elif a is InputEventJoypadMotion and b is InputEventJoypadMotion:
		return a.axis == b.axis and signf(a.axis_value) == signf(b.axis_value)
	return false

func _input_dropdown(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	var parent_phase := _get_entry_float_index(dropdown_parent_index) * float_phase_offset
	var f := _compute_float(parent_phase)
	var tf := Transform2D(f.z, Vector2(f.x, f.y))
	var inv_tf := tf.affine_inverse()

	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		match event.keycode:
			KEY_UP, KEY_W:
				dropdown_selected = (dropdown_selected - 1 + dropdown_options.size()) % dropdown_options.size()
				queue_redraw()
			KEY_DOWN, KEY_S:
				dropdown_selected = (dropdown_selected + 1) % dropdown_options.size()
				queue_redraw()
			KEY_ENTER, KEY_KP_ENTER, KEY_SPACE:
				_set_setting(dropdown_target, dropdown_options[dropdown_selected])
				dropdown_open = false
				_rebuild_current_page()
			KEY_ESCAPE:
				dropdown_open = false
				_rebuild_current_page()
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		var local_pos = inv_tf * event.position
		var dd_rect := _get_dropdown_rect()
		if dd_rect.has_point(local_pos):
			var idx := int((local_pos.y - dd_rect.position.y - dropdown_padding) / line_height)
			if idx >= 0 and idx < dropdown_options.size():
				_set_setting(dropdown_target, dropdown_options[idx])
		dropdown_open = false
		_rebuild_current_page()
	elif event is InputEventMouseMotion:
		var local_pos = inv_tf * event.position
		var dd_rect := _get_dropdown_rect()
		if dd_rect.has_point(local_pos):
			var idx := int((local_pos.y - dd_rect.position.y - dropdown_padding) / line_height)
			if idx >= 0 and idx < dropdown_options.size() and idx != dropdown_selected:
				dropdown_selected = idx
				queue_redraw()

func _input_rebind(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		if event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
			awaiting_input = false
			_rebuild_current_page()
			return
		_assign_action_event(rebinding_action, event)
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		_assign_action_event(rebinding_action, event)

func _assign_action_event(action: String, event: InputEvent) -> void:
	var events := InputMap.action_get_events(action)
	InputMap.action_erase_events(action)
	InputMap.action_add_event(action, event)
	for i in range(1, events.size()):
		InputMap.action_add_event(action, events[i])
	_set_dirty(true)
	awaiting_input = false
	_rebuild_current_page()

func _activate_selected() -> void:
	if selected_index < 0 or selected_index >= entries.size():
		return
	var entry := entries[selected_index]
	match entry.action:
		"toggle":
			var key: String = entry.param
			_set_setting(key, not bool(_get_setting(key, false)))
			_rebuild_current_page()
		"cycle":
			dropdown_open = true
			dropdown_target = entry.param
			dropdown_options = entry.options
			dropdown_selected = maxi(0, entry.options.find(_get_setting(entry.param, entry.options[0])))
			dropdown_parent_index = selected_index
			var line_y := padding + line_height * 2 + (selected_index - scroll_offset) * line_height
			dropdown_anchor = Vector2(padding + 200, line_y + line_height)
			queue_redraw()
		"rebind":
			binding_mode = true
			rebinding_action = entry.param
			queue_redraw()
		"reset_keys":
			_reset_keys_action()

func _adjust_option(dir: int) -> void:
	if selected_index < 0 or selected_index >= entries.size():
		return
	var entry := entries[selected_index]
	if entry.action == "adjust":
		var key: String = entry.param
		var val := clampi(int(_get_setting(key, 0)) + dir * 5, int(entry.min), int(entry.max))
		_set_setting(key, val)
		_rebuild_current_page()
	elif entry.action == "cycle":
		var opts: Array = entry.options
		var current = _get_setting(entry.param, opts[0])
		var idx := opts.find(current)
		idx = (idx + dir + opts.size()) % opts.size()
		_set_setting(entry.param, opts[idx])
		_rebuild_current_page()

func _save_all() -> void:
	var gs := _gs()
	if gs != null:
		if gs.has_method("save_settings"): gs.save_settings()
		if gs.has_method("save_player_input_map"): gs.save_player_input_map()
		if gs.has_method("apply_settings"): gs.apply_settings()
	_set_dirty(false)
	_rebuild_current_page()

func _exit_to_main_menu() -> void:
	var sm := get_node_or_null("/root/SceneManager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("return_to_previous_scene"):
		sm.return_to_previous_scene()
	elif get_parent() != null and get_parent() != get_tree().root:
		queue_free()
	else:
		get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/main scenes/cutscene.tscn")

func _get_custom_actions() -> Array[String]:
	var result: Array[String] = []
	for action in InputMap.get_actions():
		if not str(action).begins_with("ui_"):
			result.append(str(action))
	return result

func _bool_text(label: String, value: bool) -> String:
	return "%s: [%s]" % [label, "ONLINE" if value else "OFFLINE"]

func _slider_entry(label: String, key: String, min_val: float, max_val: float) -> Dictionary:
	var value := int(_get_setting(key, min_val))
	var bar_str := _slider_bar(value, min_val, max_val)
	return {
		"text": "%s: [%s] %d%%" % [label, bar_str, value],
		"action": "adjust",
		"param": key,
		"min": min_val,
		"max": max_val,
		"label": label,
		"bar": bar_str
	}

func _cycle_entry(label: String, key: String, options: Array) -> Dictionary:
	var current = _get_setting(key, options[0])
	var display := "Uncapped" if key == "max_fps" and int(current) == 0 else str(current)
	return {"text": "%s: < %s >" % [label, display], "action": "cycle", "param": key, "options": options}

func _slider_bar(value: float, min_val: float, max_val: float, width: int = 18) -> String:
	var ratio := (value - min_val) / maxf(max_val - min_val, 1.0)
	var filled := int(ratio * width)
	return "Ã¢â€“Ë†".repeat(filled) + "Ã‚Â·".repeat(width - filled)

extends Node2D
## The opening briefing. It plays as the real first morning: story, the supply request screen,
## building, wiring, solar stacking, failures and both hazards, then drops into Day 1.
## Every box locks input until the player reads it. Important boxes darken the screen.
@export_group("Commander")
@export var commander_sprite: Texture2D          ## leave empty to auto-use the captain art
@export var commander_name: String = "COMMANDER"
@export_group("Supply screen highlights (fractions of the screen)")
@export var shop_top := Rect2(0.03, 0.02, 0.94, 0.13)
@export var shop_list := Rect2(0.03, 0.16, 0.56, 0.68)
@export var shop_info := Rect2(0.60, 0.16, 0.37, 0.68)
@export var shop_buttons := Rect2(0.03, 0.85, 0.94, 0.13)
@export var hud_area := Rect2(0.0, 0.0, 0.30, 0.34)   ## where your air / warmth / health bars sit

const GAME_SCENE := "res://scenes/main scenes/game.tscn"
const GameScript := preload("res://scripts/main scenes/game.gd")
const CAPTAIN_FRAMES := "res://sprites/space station tileset/godot/spriteframes/captain.tres"

signal _ev(kind: String)

var _tracked_module: BaseModule
var _saved_inventory: Dictionary
var _saved_pending: Dictionary
var _saved_phase: int
var _saved_mass: float
var _speaker_texture: Texture2D

var _shop: Control

var _done := false

func _ready() -> void:
	_saved_inventory = GameManager.inventory.duplicate(true)
	_saved_pending = GameManager.pending_delivery.duplicate(true)
	_saved_phase = GameManager.current_phase
	_saved_mass = GameManager.mass_budget
	GameManager.current_phase = GameManager.Phase.BUILD
	GameManager.mass_budget = GameManager.budget_for_day(1)
	for key in GameManager.inventory:
		GameManager.inventory[key] = 0
	for key in GameManager.pending_delivery:
		GameManager.pending_delivery[key] = 0
	var player := $Player as Node2D
	$BuildCamera.enabled = false
	player.enable_player()
	_speaker_texture = _find_portrait(player)
	_build_objective_label()
	EventBus.player_moved.connect(func(_p: Node2D) -> void: _ev.emit("moved"))
	EventBus.module_placed.connect(func(m: BaseModule) -> void: _ev.emit("placed:" + m.module_name))
	EventBus.module_built.connect(func(m: BaseModule) -> void: _ev.emit("built:" + m.module_name))
	EventBus.wire_connected.connect(_on_wire_connected)
	_run()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ plumbing
func _find_portrait(player: Node2D) -> Texture2D:
	if commander_sprite != null:
		return commander_sprite
	if Dialogue.character_sprite != null:
		return Dialogue.character_sprite
	if ResourceLoader.exists(CAPTAIN_FRAMES):
		var sf := load(CAPTAIN_FRAMES) as SpriteFrames
		if sf != null:
			for anim in sf.get_animation_names():
				if sf.get_frame_count(anim) > 0:
					return sf.get_frame_texture(anim, 0)
	var sprite := player.get_node_or_null("Sprite2D") as Sprite2D
	if sprite != null and sprite.texture != null:
		var atlas := AtlasTexture.new()
		atlas.atlas = sprite.texture
		var cell := sprite.texture.get_size() / Vector2(sprite.hframes, sprite.vframes)
		atlas.region = Rect2(Vector2(sprite.frame % sprite.hframes, floori(float(sprite.frame) / sprite.hframes)) * cell, cell)
		return atlas
	return null

func _build_objective_label() -> void:
	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
	layer.layer = 70
	add_child(layer)
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	panel.position = Vector2(16, 16)
	var sb := GlassUI.panel(Color(0.03, 0.10, 0.16, 0.9), Color(0.55, 1.0, 0.78), 12, 10)
	sb.content_margin_left = 14
	sb.content_margin_right = 14
	sb.content_margin_top = 6
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 6
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	_objective_label = Label.new()
	_objective_label.add_theme_font_override("font", GameFont.get_font())
	_objective_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
	_objective_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.75, 1.0, 0.9))
	panel.add_child(_objective_label)
	layer.add_child(panel)
	panel.visible = false
	_objective_label.set_meta("panel", panel)

func _objective(text: String) -> void:
	var panel: Control = _objective_label.get_meta("panel")
	panel.visible = text != ""
	_objective_label.text = text

func _lock(locked: bool) -> void:
	($Player as Node).call("set_input_locked", locked)

func _wait(kind: String) -> void:
	while true:
		var k: String = await _ev
		if k == kind:
			return

func _on_wire_connected(wire: Node2D, receiver: Node2D) -> void:
	var src: Variant = wire.get("source_module")
	var dst := receiver.get_parent()
	if src is BaseModule and dst is BaseModule:
		_ev.emit("wire:%s>%s" % [(src as BaseModule).module_name, (dst as BaseModule).module_name])

## One commander box. dim = darken everything but the box. anchor/spot may be a node.
func _say(text: String, dim: bool = false, anchor: Variant = null, spot: Variant = null) -> void:
	if anchor == null:
		anchor = Dialogue.SCREEN if dim else $Player
	await Dialogue.say(text, anchor, commander_name, _speaker_texture, dim, spot)

func _vp() -> Vector2:
	return get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size

func _frac(r: Rect2) -> Rect2:
	var v := _vp()
	return Rect2(r.position.x * v.x, r.position.y * v.y, r.size.x * v.x, r.size.y * v.y)

func _give(item: String, count: int) -> void:
	GameManager.inventory[item] = GameManager.inventory.get(item, 0) + count

func _chapter_story() -> void:
	await _say("Can you hear me? Good. Stay where you are, you're safe now.", true)
	await _say("I'm the commander. I run the Mars teams from our main base, a few thousand kilometers from you.", true)
	await _say("The solar flare that hit your lander knocked out your guidance. You came down in Hellas Planitia, the deepest basin on Mars, about seven kilometers below the surrounding ground.", true)
	await _say("You survived the landing, and this base took less damage than we feared. It still needs a lot of work.", true)
	await _say("Rescue is five days out. Your job is to keep this base alive until then. Power, air, and heat.", true)
	await _say("I'm on Mars too, so there's no delay on this channel. Earth is different. A message to them takes between three and twenty-two minutes each way, so out here we solve our own problems.", true)

func _chapter_crew() -> void:
	await _say("You're not alone. Three of my crew have spent the last few months building outposts across this region. They know this planet.", true)
	await _say("They're hundreds of kilometers away, so they can't walk over. They drive supplies to you in a rover.", true)
	await _say("Every morning you tell them what you need. They load the rover and bring it to your base.", true)
	await _say("A rover can only carry so much weight, and it only makes one trip a day. Whatever isn't on it, you won't have until tomorrow.", true)

func _chapter_supplies() -> void:

func _exit_tree() -> void:
	Dialogue.hide_dialogue()
	Hazards.clear()
	GameManager.inventory = _saved_inventory
	GameManager.pending_delivery = _saved_pending
	GameManager.current_phase = _saved_phase
	GameManager.mass_budget = _saved_mass
	for i in range(BaseManager.active_modules.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		var module: Node = BaseManager.active_modules[i]
		if not is_instance_valid(module) or is_ancestor_of(module):
			BaseManager.active_modules.remove_at(i)
	BaseManager.calculate_power()

================================================================================
FILE: scripts\polish\module_art.gd
================================================================================

extends Node2D
class_name ModuleArt

const GHOST_CODE := """shader_type canvas_item;
uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(0.35, 0.85, 1.3, 1.0);
varying vec2 wpos;
void vertex() {
	wpos = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 0.0, 1.0)).xy;
}
void fragment() {
	float l = dot(COLOR.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
	float lines = 0.7 + 0.3 * step(0.5, fract(wpos.y * 0.3));
	float sweep = pow(max(0.0, sin(wpos.y * 0.045 - TIME * 2.6)), 20.0);
	vec3 c = tint.rgb * (0.25 + l * 1.15) * lines + tint.rgb * sweep * 0.7;
	COLOR = vec4(c, COLOR.a * 0.92);
}
"""

static var _ghost_shader: Shader

var host: BaseModule
var kind: String = ""
var rect := Rect2(0, 0, 256, 256)
var ghost := false
var t := 0.0
var spin := 0.0
var flow := 0.0
var slow := 0.0
var power_k := 0.0
var broken_k := 0.0
var build_k := 1.0
var box := StyleBoxFlat.new()
var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
var _blocked := false
var _synced := false
var _phase := 0.0

static func make_ghost_material() -> ShaderMaterial:
	if _ghost_shader == null:
		_ghost_shader = Shader.new()
		_ghost_shader.code = GHOST_CODE
	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
	m.shader = _ghost_shader
	return m

func _ready() -> void:
	host = get_parent() as BaseModule
	if host == null:
		set_process(false)
		return
	kind = host.module_name
	ghost = bool(host.get_meta("is_ghost", false))
	_phase = randf() * 10.0
	t = _phase
	box.anti_aliasing = true
	var col := host.get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	if col != null and col.shape is RectangleShape2D:
		var sz: Vector2 = (col.shape as RectangleShape2D).size
		rect = Rect2(col.position - sz * 0.5, sz)
	if ghost:
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
		power_k = 1.0
		material = make_ghost_material()
		_sync_ghost()

func _is_active() -> bool:
	if ghost:
		return true
	if host.is_broken or host.is_constructing:
		return false
	if kind == "Solar Panel":
		return true
	if kind == "Reactor":
		return BaseManager.reactor_energy > 0.0
	return host.is_powered

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if host == null:
		return
	t += delta
	var target := 1.0 if _is_active() else 0.0
	power_k = lerpf(power_k, target, 1.0 - exp(-5.0 * delta))
	broken_k = lerpf(broken_k, 1.0 if host.is_broken else 0.0, 1.0 - exp(-8.0 * delta))
	build_k = clampf(host.build_progress / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0) if host.is_constructing else 1.0
	spin += delta * 9.0 * power_k
	flow += delta * 70.0 * power_k
	slow += delta * (0.35 + 0.9 * power_k)
	if ghost:
		_sync_ghost()
	queue_redraw()

func _sync_ghost() -> void:
	var m := host.modulate
	var blocked := m.r > m.b * 1.4
	if _synced and blocked == _blocked:
		return
	_synced = true
	_blocked = blocked
	var tint := Color(1.8, 0.35, 0.3) if blocked else Color(0.35, 0.85, 1.3)
	(material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("tint", tint)
	for ch in host.get_children():
		if ch is CanvasItem and (ch as CanvasItem).material is ShaderMaterial:
			((ch as CanvasItem).material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("tint", tint)

func _col(c: Color, k: float, a: float = 1.0) -> Color:
	return Color(c.r * k, c.g * k, c.b * k, a)

func _rbox(r: Rect2, fill: Color, border: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0), radius: int = 6, bw: int = 0) -> void:
	box.bg_color = fill
	box.border_color = border
	box.set_border_width_all(bw)
	box.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
	draw_style_box(box, r)

func _glow(p: Vector2, rad: float, col: Color, a: float) -> void:
	for i in 5:
		var k := float(i) / 4.0
		draw_circle(p, rad * (1.0 + k * 1.3), Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, a * (1.0 - k) * 0.28))

func _disc(p: Vector2, rad: float, fill: Color, rim: Color, w: float) -> void:
	draw_circle(p, rad, fill)
	draw_arc(p, rad, 0.0, TAU, 48, rim, w, true)

func _led(p: Vector2, col: Color, on: float) -> void:
	var lit := on * (0.65 + 0.35 * sin(t * 5.0 + p.x))
	draw_circle(p, 3.6, Color(0.04, 0.05, 0.07))
	draw_circle(p, 2.5, col.darkened(0.75).lerp(_col(col, 1.3), lit))
	if lit > 0.3:
		_glow(p, 3.0, col, lit)

func _bolts(r: Rect2, inset: float) -> void:
	for i in 4:
		var p := Vector2(r.position.x + inset if i % 2 == 0 else r.end.x - inset, r.position.y + inset if i < 2 else r.end.y - inset)
		draw_circle(p, 3.4, Color(0.3, 0.34, 0.4))
		draw_circle(p, 1.6, Color(0.1, 0.11, 0.14))

func _brackets(r: Rect2, col: Color, ln: float, w: float) -> void:
	var corners: Array[Vector2] = [r.position, Vector2(r.end.x, r.position.y), r.end, Vector2(r.position.x, r.end.y)]
	var sx: Array[float] = [1.0, -1.0, -1.0, 1.0]
	var sy: Array[float] = [1.0, 1.0, -1.0, -1.0]
	for i in 4:
		var p: Vector2 = corners[i]
		draw_line(p, p + Vector2(ln * sx[i], 0.0), col, w)
		draw_line(p, p + Vector2(0.0, ln * sy[i]), col, w)

func _hex(c: Vector2, rad: float, rot: float = 0.0) -> PackedVector2Array:
	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
	for i in 6:
		pts.append(c + Vector2.from_angle(rot + i * PI / 3.0) * rad)
	return pts

func _loop(pts: PackedVector2Array) -> PackedVector2Array:
	var out := pts.duplicate()
	out.append(pts[0])
	return out

func _path_len(pts: PackedVector2Array) -> float:
	var total := 0.0
	for i in pts.size() - 1:
		total += pts[i].distance_to(pts[i + 1])
	return total

func _path_point(pts: PackedVector2Array, s: float) -> Vector2:
	var rem := s
	for i in pts.size() - 1:
		var seg := pts[i].distance_to(pts[i + 1])
		if rem <= seg:
			return pts[i].lerp(pts[i + 1], rem / maxf(seg, 0.001))
		rem -= seg
	return pts[pts.size() - 1]

func _draw() -> void:
	if host == null:
		return
	if not ghost:
		_rbox(Rect2(rect.position + Vector2(6, 10), rect.size), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 12, 0)
	match kind:
		"Solar Panel":
			_draw_solar()
		"Reactor":
			_draw_reactor()
		"Life Support":
			_draw_life()
		"Thermal Control":
			_draw_thermal()
		"Shield":
			_draw_shield()
		"Comms":
			_draw_comms()
		_:
			_rbox(rect, Color(0.2, 0.22, 0.28), Color(0.6, 0.65, 0.75), 8, 3)
	if ghost:
		_draw_blueprint()
	elif host.is_constructing:
		_draw_scaffold()
	else:
		_draw_state()

func _draw_solar() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var c := r.get_center()
	var on := power_k
	var gold := Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.25)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.17, 0.19, 0.24), Color(0.62, 0.68, 0.78), 8, 3)
	var inner := Rect2(r.position + Vector2(12, 12), Vector2(r.size.x - 50.0, r.size.y - 24.0))
	_rbox(inner, Color(0.04, 0.06, 0.1), Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.05), 4, 2)
	var cols := 4
	var rows := 3
	var gap := 4.0
	var cw := (inner.size.x - gap * (cols + 1)) / cols
	var ch := (inner.size.y - gap * (rows + 1)) / rows
	for j in rows:
		for i in cols:
			var cr := Rect2(inner.position + Vector2(gap + i * (cw + gap), gap + j * (ch + gap)), Vector2(cw, ch))
			var wave := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 2.4 - float(i + j) * 0.8)
			var glow := on * wave
			_rbox(cr, Color(0.05, 0.1, 0.24).lerp(Color(0.1, 0.32, 0.66), glow), Color(0.5, 0.68, 0.95, 0.55), 2, 1)
			for k in range(1, 4):
				var x := cr.position.x + cw * k / 4.0
				draw_line(Vector2(x, cr.position.y + 1.0), Vector2(x, cr.end.y - 1.0), Color(0.45, 0.65, 1.0, 0.28), 1.0)
			for k in range(1, 3):
				var y := cr.position.y + ch * k / 3.0
				draw_line(Vector2(cr.position.x + 1.0, y), Vector2(cr.end.x - 1.0, y), Color(0.45, 0.65, 1.0, 0.28), 1.0)
			draw_rect(cr, Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.6, glow * 0.16))
			draw_line(cr.position + Vector2(cw * 0.2, ch * 0.9), cr.position + Vector2(cw * 0.8, ch * 0.1), Color(1, 1, 1, glow * 0.4), 1.5, true)
	var jb := Rect2(r.end.x - 34.0, c.y - 36.0, 34.0, 72.0)
	_rbox(jb, Color(0.22, 0.24, 0.3), Color(0.7, 0.74, 0.82), 4, 2)
	_rbox(jb.grow(-6.0), Color(0.07, 0.08, 0.11), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 3, 0)
	for k in 3:
		_led(Vector2(jb.position.x + 17.0, jb.position.y + 18.0 + k * 18.0), gold if k != 1 else Color(0.3, 1.0, 0.5), on)
	draw_line(Vector2(jb.end.x - 6.0, c.y), Vector2(r.end.x + 4.0, c.y), _col(gold, 0.4 + 1.2 * on, 0.4 + 0.6 * on), 4.0, true)
	_bolts(r, 6.0)

func _draw_reactor() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var c := r.get_center()
	var energy := clampf(BaseManager.reactor_energy / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)
	var on := power_k
	var cyan := Color(0.2, 0.95, 1.0)
	var core_col := cyan.lerp(Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.15), 1.0 - energy)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.1, 0.13, 0.17), Color(0.2, 0.75, 0.9), 14, 3)
	_rbox(r.grow(-8.0), Color(0.05, 0.07, 0.1), Color(0.14, 0.26, 0.32), 10, 1)
	for si in 2:
		var s := -1.0 if si == 0 else 1.0
		for i in 3:
			var x := c.x + s * (70.0 + i * 16.0)
			var h := 64.0
			_rbox(Rect2(x - 5.0, c.y - h * 0.5, 10.0, h), Color(0.08, 0.12, 0.16), Color(0.2, 0.3, 0.36), 3, 1)
			var fill := clampf(energy * on * (0.65 + 0.35 * sin(t * 3.0 - i * 0.8 + s)), 0.0, 1.0)
			var fh := maxf((h - 6.0) * fill, 1.0)
			_rbox(Rect2(x - 3.0, c.y + h * 0.5 - 3.0 - fh, 6.0, fh), _col(core_col, 0.5 + 0.8 * on), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 2, 0)
		_rbox(Rect2(c.x + s * 120.0 - 6.0, c.y - 26.0, 12.0, 52.0), Color(0.03, 0.04, 0.06), Color(0.25, 0.4, 0.48), 3, 1)
	_disc(c, 47.0, Color(0.05, 0.07, 0.1), Color(0.35, 0.42, 0.5), 3.0)
	_disc(c, 39.0, Color(0.08, 0.11, 0.15), Color(0.2, 0.25, 0.3), 2.0)
	if on > 0.01:
		_glow(c, 26.0, core_col, on)
	for i in 3:
		var a := slow * (1.6 + 0.3 * i) + i * TAU / 3.0
		draw_arc(c, 33.0 - i * 5.0, a, a + 1.7, 18, Color(core_col.r, core_col.g, core_col.b, 0.25 + 0.65 * on), 3.0, true)
	var pulse := 1.0 + 0.12 * sin(t * 6.0)
	draw_circle(c, 16.0 * pulse * (0.45 + 0.55 * on), _col(core_col, 0.35 + 1.3 * on))
	draw_circle(c, 7.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35 + 0.65 * on))
	draw_arc(c, 52.0, 0.0, TAU, 64, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.08), 4.0, true)
	if energy > 0.01:
		draw_arc(c, 52.0, -PI * 0.5, -PI * 0.5 + TAU * energy, 64, _col(core_col, 1.2), 4.0, true)

func _draw_life() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var c := r.get_center()
	var on := power_k
	var teal := Color(0.2, 0.95, 0.8)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.09, 0.15, 0.17), Color(0.25, 0.8, 0.75), 12, 3)
	_rbox(r.grow(-10.0), Color(0.06, 0.1, 0.12), Color(0.12, 0.3, 0.32), 8, 1)
	_bolts(r, 10.0)
	var tpos: Array[Vector2] = [Vector2(c.x - 58.0, c.y - 62.0), Vector2(c.x + 58.0, c.y - 62.0)]
	var pipe_y := c.y + 8.0
	draw_line(Vector2(tpos[0].x, tpos[0].y + 30.0), Vector2(tpos[0].x, pipe_y), Color(0.3, 0.38, 0.42), 11.0)
	draw_line(Vector2(tpos[1].x, tpos[1].y + 30.0), Vector2(tpos[1].x, pipe_y), Color(0.3, 0.38, 0.42), 11.0)
	draw_line(Vector2(tpos[0].x, pipe_y), Vector2(tpos[1].x, pipe_y), Color(0.3, 0.38, 0.42), 11.0)
	draw_line(Vector2(c.x, pipe_y), Vector2(c.x, c.y + 24.0), Color(0.3, 0.38, 0.42), 11.0)
	draw_line(Vector2(tpos[0].x + 2.0, pipe_y - 2.0), Vector2(tpos[1].x - 2.0, pipe_y - 2.0), _col(teal, 0.3 + 0.7 * on, 0.6), 2.0)
	for ti in 2:
		var tp: Vector2 = tpos[ti]
		_disc(tp, 44.0, Color(0.1, 0.18, 0.2), Color(0.35, 0.55, 0.6), 3.0)
		_disc(tp, 36.0, Color(0.06, 0.14, 0.16), Color(0.15, 0.4, 0.42), 2.0)
		var lvl := 0.3 + 0.7 * on
		draw_circle(tp, 29.0, Color(0.05 + 0.1 * lvl, 0.2 + 0.5 * lvl, 0.2 + 0.45 * lvl, 0.95))
		if on > 0.05:
			_glow(tp, 20.0, teal, on * 0.7)
			for b in 5:
				var ph := fposmod(t * 0.45 + b * 0.2 + ti * 0.37, 1.0)
				var bp := tp + Vector2(sin(ph * 9.0 + b) * 10.0, 22.0 - ph * 46.0)
				draw_circle(bp, 2.0 + float(b % 3) * 0.7, Color(0.8, 1.0, 1.0, (1.0 - ph) * 0.7 * on))
		draw_arc(tp, 22.0, PI * 1.1, PI * 1.7, 12, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35), 3.0, true)
		for k in 12:
			var a := k * TAU / 12.0
			draw_line(tp + Vector2.from_angle(a) * 38.0, tp + Vector2.from_angle(a) * 42.0, Color(0.5, 0.75, 0.8, 0.7), 2.0)
	var fc := Vector2(c.x, c.y + 72.0)
	_disc(fc, 50.0, Color(0.08, 0.12, 0.14), Color(0.4, 0.6, 0.65), 3.0)
	draw_circle(fc, 45.0, Color(teal.r, teal.g, teal.b, 0.1 * on))
	for b in 5:
		var a := spin + b * TAU / 5.0
		var blade := PackedVector2Array([
			fc + Vector2.from_angle(a) * 8.0,
			fc + Vector2.from_angle(a - 0.18) * 43.0,
			fc + Vector2.from_angle(a + 0.5) * 41.0,
			fc + Vector2.from_angle(a + 0.55) * 10.0])
		draw_colored_polygon(blade, Color(0.35, 0.6, 0.62).lerp(teal, on * 0.5))
	_disc(fc, 9.0, Color(0.15, 0.2, 0.22), _col(teal, 0.5 + 0.8 * on), 2.0)
	for si in 2:
		var s := -1.0 if si == 0 else 1.0
		for k in 5:
			var vx := c.x + s * (72.0 + k * 8.0)
			draw_line(Vector2(vx, c.y + 56.0), Vector2(vx, c.y + 100.0), Color(0.03, 0.06, 0.07), 3.0)

func _draw_thermal() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var on := power_k
	var hot := Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.12)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.16, 0.1, 0.08), Color(0.9, 0.4, 0.15), 10, 3)
	_rbox(r.grow(-8.0), Color(0.1, 0.07, 0.06), Color(0.3, 0.15, 0.1), 6, 1)
	for si in 2:
		var fx := r.position.x + 14.0 if si == 0 else r.end.x - 36.0
		for i in 8:
			var fy := r.position.y + 16.0 + i * 20.5
			var heat := on * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 3.0 - i * 0.6 + si * PI))
			_rbox(Rect2(fx, fy, 22.0, 12.0), Color(0.28, 0.22, 0.2).lerp(hot, heat * 0.85), Color(0.08, 0.06, 0.05), 2, 1)
	var br := Rect2(r.position + Vector2(44, 16), Vector2(r.size.x - 88.0, r.size.y - 32.0))
	_rbox(br, Color(0.07, 0.05, 0.05), Color(0.5, 0.25, 0.12), 6, 2)
	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
	var rows := 6
	for i in rows:
		var y := br.position.y + 18.0 + i * ((br.size.y - 36.0) / (rows - 1))
		var lx := br.position.x + 14.0
		var rx := br.end.x - 14.0
		if i % 2 == 0:
			pts.append(Vector2(lx, y))
			pts.append(Vector2(rx, y))
		else:
			pts.append(Vector2(rx, y))
			pts.append(Vector2(lx, y))
	draw_polyline(pts, Color(0.22, 0.13, 0.1), 9.0, true)
	draw_polyline(pts, _col(hot, 0.3 + 1.1 * on), 5.0, true)
	if on > 0.05:
		var total := _path_len(pts)
		for k in 6:
			var p := _path_point(pts, fposmod(flow + k * total / 6.0, total))
			_glow(p, 3.5, Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.4), on * 0.8)
			draw_circle(p, 3.0, Color(1.6, 1.3, 0.8, on))
	var gauge := clampf(BaseManager.temp_level / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)
	var gc := Vector2(br.get_center().x, br.position.y - 1.0)
	draw_arc(gc, 9.0, 0.0, PI, 12, Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.25), 3.0, true)
	draw_arc(gc, 9.0, PI, PI + PI * gauge, 12, Color(0.4, 0.9, 1.0).lerp(hot, 1.0 - gauge), 3.0, true)

func _draw_shield() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var c := r.get_center()
	var on := power_k
	var vio := Color(0.65, 0.4, 1.0)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.1, 0.08, 0.16), Color(0.55, 0.35, 0.95), 12, 3)
	_rbox(r.grow(-8.0), Color(0.07, 0.05, 0.11), Color(0.25, 0.15, 0.4), 8, 1)
	_bolts(r, 11.0)
	var hr := 70.0
	var hp := _hex(c, hr)
	draw_colored_polygon(hp, Color(0.05, 0.04, 0.09))
	draw_polyline(_loop(hp), _col(vio, 0.5 + 0.8 * on), 3.0, true)
	for i in 7:
		var off := Vector2.ZERO if i == 0 else Vector2.from_angle(PI / 6.0 + (i - 1) * PI / 3.0) * 31.2
		var hc := c + off
		var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 3.0 - i * 0.9)
		var hx := _hex(hc, 17.0)
		draw_colored_polygon(hx, Color(vio.r, vio.g, vio.b, 0.08 + 0.4 * on * pulse))
		draw_polyline(_loop(hx), _col(vio, 0.45 + 0.9 * on * pulse), 2.0, true)
	for k in 6:
		var v := c + Vector2.from_angle(k * PI / 3.0) * hr
		if on > 0.05:
			_glow(v, 6.0, vio, on)
		_disc(v, 6.5, Color(0.12, 0.09, 0.2), _col(vio, 0.6 + 0.8 * on), 2.0)
		draw_circle(v, 2.5, _col(vio, 0.4 + 1.4 * on))
	for k in 12:
		var a := slow * 0.9 + k * TAU / 12.0
		draw_arc(c, 84.0, a, a + 0.32, 6, Color(vio.r, vio.g, vio.b, 0.3 + 0.6 * on), 3.0, true)
	var d := 11.0 + 2.0 * sin(t * 4.0) * on
	var diamond := PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(0, -d * 1.4), c + Vector2(d, 0), c + Vector2(0, d * 1.4), c + Vector2(-d, 0)])
	draw_colored_polygon(diamond, _col(vio, 0.4 + 1.5 * on))
	draw_polyline(_loop(diamond), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.3 + 0.6 * on), 1.5, true)
	if on > 0.02:
		var br := 122.0 + 5.0 * sin(t * 2.0)
		draw_circle(c, br, Color(vio.r, vio.g, vio.b, 0.05 * on))
		draw_arc(c, br, 0.0, TAU, 72, Color(vio.r, vio.g, vio.b, 0.35 * on), 3.0, true)
		draw_arc(c, br - 8.0, 0.0, TAU, 72, Color(1.0, 0.8, 1.0, 0.12 * on), 1.5, true)

func _draw_comms() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var c := r.get_center()
	var on := power_k
	var pink := Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.7)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.14, 0.09, 0.13), Color(0.9, 0.3, 0.6), 10, 3)
	_rbox(r.grow(-8.0), Color(0.09, 0.06, 0.09), Color(0.3, 0.13, 0.25), 6, 1)
	var rack := Rect2(r.position + Vector2(14, 14), Vector2(52.0, r.size.y - 28.0))
	_rbox(rack, Color(0.06, 0.04, 0.07), Color(0.4, 0.2, 0.35), 4, 2)
	for i in 6:
		var ry := rack.position.y + 7.0 + i * ((rack.size.y - 14.0) / 6.0)
		_rbox(Rect2(rack.position.x + 5.0, ry, rack.size.x - 10.0, 10.0), Color(0.14, 0.1, 0.15), Color(0.3, 0.2, 0.3), 2, 1)
		_led(Vector2(rack.position.x + 13.0, ry + 5.0), pink if i % 2 == 0 else Color(0.4, 1.0, 0.6), on)
		var bar := (0.3 + 0.7 * absf(sin(t * 2.0 + i * 1.3))) * on
		draw_rect(Rect2(rack.position.x + 22.0, ry + 3.0, (rack.size.x - 32.0) * bar, 4.0), _col(pink, 0.8 + 0.6 * on))
	var dc := Vector2(r.end.x - 62.0, c.y)
	_disc(dc, 52.0, Color(0.13, 0.11, 0.14), Color(0.8, 0.8, 0.9), 3.0)
	for k in 4:
		draw_arc(dc, 44.0 - k * 10.0, 0.0, TAU, 40, Color(0.75, 0.75, 0.85, 0.2 + 0.08 * k), 2.0, true)
	for k in 10:
		var a := k * TAU / 10.0
		draw_line(dc + Vector2.from_angle(a) * 8.0, dc + Vector2.from_angle(a) * 50.0, Color(0.55, 0.55, 0.65, 0.55), 1.5)
	var aim := sin(slow * 1.1 + _phase) * 0.5
	var feed := dc + Vector2.from_angle(aim) * 34.0
	draw_line(dc, feed, Color(0.7, 0.7, 0.8), 4.0, true)
	_disc(dc, 8.0, Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.25), Color(0.8, 0.8, 0.9), 2.0)
	if on > 0.05:
		_glow(feed, 6.0, pink, on)
	_disc(feed, 6.0, Color(0.2, 0.1, 0.16), _col(pink, 0.6 + 0.9 * on), 2.0)
	if on > 0.05:
		for i in 3:
			var rr := fposmod(t * 34.0 + i * 14.0, 42.0)
			draw_arc(feed, rr + 8.0, aim - 0.7, aim + 0.7, 12, Color(pink.r, pink.g, pink.b, (1.0 - rr / 42.0) * 0.9 * on), 2.5, true)
	var blink := 1.0 if fmod(t, 1.2) < 0.2 else 0.15
	_led(Vector2(rack.end.x + 12.0, r.position.y + 18.0), Color(1.0, 0.25, 0.2), on * blink)

func _draw_state() -> void:
	var c := rect.get_center()
	var idle := 1.0 - power_k
	if idle > 0.02 and not host.is_broken:
		_rbox(rect, Color(0.01, 0.02, 0.04, 0.5 * idle), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 8, 0)
		var blink := 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(t * 4.0)
		_bolt_icon(c, Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.2, idle * blink))
	if broken_k > 0.02:
		var fl := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 14.0)
		_rbox(rect, Color(1.0, 0.08, 0.05, 0.22 * broken_k * (0.4 + 0.6 * fl)), Color(1.0, 0.2, 0.15, broken_k * fl), 8, 3)
		_warn_icon(c, broken_k, fl)

func _bolt_icon(p: Vector2, col: Color) -> void:
	var pts := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(3, -22), Vector2(-9, 2), Vector2(-1, 2), Vector2(-4, 22), Vector2(10, -4), Vector2(2, -4)])
	for i in pts.size():
		pts[i] += p
	draw_colored_polygon(pts, col)
	draw_line(p + Vector2(-16, -20), p + Vector2(16, 20), Color(1.0, 0.2, 0.15, col.a), 3.5, true)

func _warn_icon(p: Vector2, k: float, fl: float) -> void:
	var s := 1.0 + 0.1 * fl
	var pts := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(0, -26) * s + p, Vector2(24, 18) * s + p, Vector2(-24, 18) * s + p])
	draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(1.0, 0.15, 0.1, 0.85 * k))
	draw_polyline(_loop(pts), Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.7, k), 2.5, true)
	draw_line(p + Vector2(0, -9) * s, p + Vector2(0, 5) * s, Color(1, 1, 1, k), 4.0, true)
	draw_circle(p + Vector2(0, 12) * s, 2.8, Color(1, 1, 1, k))

func _sparks(k: float) -> void:
	rng.seed = int(t * 9.0) * 7919 + 13
	for i in 5:
		var p := rect.position + Vector2(rng.randf() * rect.size.x, rng.randf() * rect.size.y)
		var d := Vector2.from_angle(rng.randf() * TAU) * (6.0 + rng.randf() * 14.0)
		draw_line(p, p + d, Color(1.8, 1.4, 0.5, k), 2.0, true)
		draw_circle(p, 2.0, Color(2.0, 1.8, 1.0, k))

func _draw_scaffold() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var cut := r.size.y * (1.0 - build_k)
	if cut > 1.0:
		_rbox(Rect2(r.position, Vector2(r.size.x, cut)), Color(0.04, 0.16, 0.28, 0.82), Color(0.3, 0.8, 1.0, 0.8), 6, 1)
		var gx := r.position.x + 16.0
		while gx < r.end.x:
			draw_line(Vector2(gx, r.position.y), Vector2(gx, r.position.y + cut), Color(0.4, 0.9, 1.0, 0.18), 1.0)
			gx += 16.0
		var gy := r.position.y + 16.0
		while gy < r.position.y + cut:
			draw_line(Vector2(r.position.x, gy), Vector2(r.end.x, gy), Color(0.4, 0.9, 1.0, 0.18), 1.0)
			gy += 16.0
	var sy := r.position.y + cut
	draw_line(Vector2(r.position.x, sy), Vector2(r.end.x, sy), Color(0.5, 1.6, 2.0, 0.95), 3.0, true)
	_brackets(r.grow(6.0), Color(0.5, 1.4, 1.8, 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(t * 8.0)), 22.0, 3.0)

func _draw_blueprint() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var gx := r.position.x + 32.0
	while gx < r.end.x - 1.0:
		draw_line(Vector2(gx, r.position.y), Vector2(gx, r.end.y), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14), 1.0)
		gx += 32.0
	var gy := r.position.y + 32.0
	while gy < r.end.y - 1.0:
		draw_line(Vector2(r.position.x, gy), Vector2(r.end.x, gy), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14), 1.0)
		gy += 32.0
	draw_line(r.position, r.end, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.1), 1.0)
	draw_line(Vector2(r.end.x, r.position.y), Vector2(r.position.x, r.end.y), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.1), 1.0)
	draw_rect(r, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55), false, 2.0)
	_brackets(r.grow(8.0), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9), 26.0, 3.0)

================================================================================
FILE: scripts\polish\polish.gd
